class_name WindkeeperEncounter
extends BossEncounter
## Fixed safe core, local attack clock, three distinct actual patterns.
signal objective_changed(text: String)
signal armour_hit(point: Vector2)
var stage_phase := 1
var mode: StringName = &"observe"
var core_open := false
var clock := 0.0
var blade_angle := 0.0
var chase_segment := 0
var attack_epoch := 0
var _floor_y := 0.0
var _pier_direction := 1
var _platform_piers:Array[float]=[]
var rune_platform := -1
var _rune_shots:Dictionary={}
var _home_x := 0.0
var _stomp_next := true
var _core: Area2D
var _core_receiver: WindkeeperDamageable
var _contact_shape: CollisionShape2D
var _blade_last_hit := -1
var _phase_cycle := 0
var _storm_fired := false
var _locked_aim := Vector2.ZERO
var _motion_age := 0.0
var transition_target := 1
var intro_seen := false
var intro_duration := 0.0
var reward_stands: Array[Vector2] = []

func continuous_combat() -> bool:
	return (definition as WindkeeperDefinition).continuous_combat

func accepts_combat_damage() -> bool:
	return active and not health.terminal and mode != &"intro"

# World bounds used by actual contact consumers; artwork never defines damage.
func body_contact_rect() -> Rect2:
	var shape := _contact_shape if is_instance_valid(_contact_shape) else motor.get_node("CollisionShape2D") as CollisionShape2D
	return shape.global_transform * shape.shape.get_rect()

func _update_combat_shapes() -> void:
	_core.position = core_offset()
	_core.collision_layer = 4 if accepts_combat_damage() and (continuous_combat() or core_open) else 0
	# Continuous fights retain a shootable body through attacks and recovery.
	# Body contact eligibility is a separate accepted encounter state.
	motor.collision_layer = (4 if accepts_combat_damage() else 0) if continuous_combat() else (0 if core_open or mode in [&"intro", &"phase_transition"] else 4)

func _ready() -> void:
	super._ready()
	motor.collision_layer = 4
	# Giant remains behind walkable bridge planes; attacks have their own shapes.
	# Arena travel limits bound its scripted horizontal locomotion.
	motor.collision_mask = 0
	(motor.get_node("Damageable") as WindkeeperDamageable).encounter = self
	_core = Area2D.new()
	_core.name = "BellCore"
	_core.collision_layer = 0
	_core.collision_mask = 0
	var shape := CollisionShape2D.new()
	var circle := CircleShape2D.new()
	circle.radius = 18
	shape.shape = circle
	_core.add_child(shape)
	_core_receiver = WindkeeperDamageable.new()
	_core_receiver.name = "Damageable"
	_core_receiver.encounter = self
	_core_receiver.primary = damageable
	_core_receiver.faction = &"enemy"
	_core_receiver.actor_id = damageable.actor_id
	_core.add_child(_core_receiver)
	motor.add_child.call_deferred(_core)
	_core_receiver.bind_health(health)
	var config := definition as WindkeeperDefinition
	if continuous_combat() and config.contact_size != Vector2.ZERO:
		var volume := Area2D.new()
		volume.name = "BodyContactVolume"
		volume.collision_layer = 0
		volume.collision_mask = 0
		_contact_shape = CollisionShape2D.new()
		_contact_shape.position = config.contact_offset
		var rect := RectangleShape2D.new()
		rect.size = config.contact_size
		_contact_shape.shape = rect
		volume.add_child(_contact_shape)
		motor.add_child.call_deferred(volume)

func configure_arena(left: float, right: float, target: Node2D) -> bool:
	if not super.configure_arena(left, right, target): return false
	_floor_y = motor.global_position.y + 65
	_home_x = (left + right) / 2
	return true

func activate() -> bool:
	if not super.activate(): return false
	intro_duration=(definition as WindkeeperDefinition).repeat_intro_seconds if intro_seen else (definition as WindkeeperDefinition).intro_seconds
	_enter(&"intro", intro_duration)
	intro_seen = true
	return true

func physics_tick(delta: float) -> void:
	_prune_attacks()
	if not active or health.terminal or delta <= 0 or not is_finite(delta): return
	var wanted := 3 if health.current <= health.capacity * (definition as WindkeeperDefinition).phase_three_health else (2 if health.current <= health.capacity * (definition as WindkeeperDefinition).phase_two_health else 1)
	if wanted != stage_phase and mode != &"phase_transition":
		_clear_attacks()
		transition_target = wanted
		stage_phase = wanted
		chase_segment = 0
		motor.stop()
		_enter(&"phase_transition", (definition as WindkeeperDefinition).phase_warning_seconds)
	clock -= delta
	if mode == &"intro":
		if clock <= 0: _enter(&"observe", 1.0)
	elif mode == &"phase_transition":
		if clock <= 0:
			if continuous_combat():
				# R3: a bounded, visible warning replaces the old indefinite safe
				# waiting/return walk. Select the closest existing pier without
				# teleporting; the following chase still uses the actual Motor.
				if transition_target == 3 and _platform_piers.size() == 3:
					var nearest := INF
					for index:int in 3:
						var distance := absf(_platform_piers[index]-motor.global_position.x)
						if distance < nearest: nearest=distance;chase_segment=index
					_pier_direction = -1 if chase_segment == 2 else 1
				phase_changed.emit(stage_phase)
				_enter(&"observe", .35)
			else:
				var destination := arena.left_x + 95 if transition_target == 3 else _home_x
				var distance := destination - motor.global_position.x
				motor.speed = (definition as WindkeeperDefinition).chase_speed
				motor.step(1 if distance > 0 else -1, absf(distance), delta)
				# Historical aperture fixture waits for a safe shelf or shore.
				var safe := _target.global_position.y <= _floor_y - 130 or _target.global_position.x < arena.left_x + 165 or _target.global_position.x > arena.right_x + 5
				if absf(distance) < 2 and (transition_target != 3 or safe):
					phase_changed.emit(stage_phase)
					_enter(&"observe", 1.2)
	elif stage_phase == 1: _ground_pattern(delta)
	elif stage_phase == 2: _wind_pattern(delta)
	else: _chase_pattern(delta)
	_update_combat_shapes()
	motor.queue_redraw()

func _enter(next: StringName, duration: float) -> void:
	mode = next
	clock = duration
	_storm_fired=false
	_motion_age=0
	if is_instance_valid(_target) and next in [&"blade_warning",&"pier_warning"]: _locked_aim=_target.global_position
	core_open = next in [&"neck", &"back", &"pier_open"]
	objective_changed.emit(objective())

func objective() -> String:
	if mode == &"intro": return (definition as WindkeeperDefinition).display_name
	if continuous_combat():
		if mode == &"phase_transition": return "地形将变化，先找落脚点 / FIND YOUR NEXT LANDING"
		if mode in [&"neck", &"back", &"pier_open"]: return "收招恢复，抓紧追击 / RECOVERY — PRESS THE ATTACK"
		if stage_phase == 1: return "随时可攻击，跳过地波并避开冲撞 / WATCH THE STOMP AND CHARGE"
		if stage_phase == 2: return "借平台躲开旋叶与风籽 / USE THE SHELVES TO EVADE"
		return "跨越断桥，避开落击后追击 / CROSS THE PIERS AND PUNISH THE LANDING"
	if mode == &"phase_transition": return "BRIDGE CRACKING — CLIMB TO THE GRASS SHELVES" if stage_phase == 3 else "WINDMILL AWAKENING — WATCH THE BACK BELL"
	if (definition as WindkeeperDefinition).storm_profile and stage_phase==2: return "持续左风：上草台，从上侧射背铃 / LEFT WIND / SHOOT BELL FROM ABOVE"
	if (definition as WindkeeperDefinition).storm_profile and stage_phase==3: return "踏亮当前草台，再起跳下射 / LAND ON LIT SHELF / JUMP & AIM DOWN" if (definition as WindkeeperDefinition).platform_trials else "跨断桥追逐，避开落击与双种子 / BROKEN BRIDGE + CROSS FIRE"
	if stage_phase == 1: return "地面瞄准颈铃，跳过地波 / GROUND AIM / SHOOT NECK BELL"
	if stage_phase == 2: return "先上草台，避开平台挡弹 / CLIMB & SHOOT BACK BELL"
	return "跨桥墩，落击后转身射铃芯 / SHOOT EXPOSED BELL"

func accepts_core_direction(context: Dictionary) -> bool:
	if continuous_combat(): return true
	var config:=definition as WindkeeperDefinition
	if config.platform_trials and stage_phase==3:
		var incoming:Vector2=context.get("hit_direction",Vector2.ZERO)
		var key:String="%s:%s"%[context.get("session_id",-1),context.get("shot_id",-1)]
		return _rune_shots.get(key,-1)==chase_segment and context.get("fired_airborne",false)==true and incoming.is_finite() and incoming.normalized().y>=config.final_upper_core_dot
	if not config.storm_profile or stage_phase!=2: return true
	# Downward incoming ray reaches the upper aperture. Side/bottom hits reject
	# with armour feedback; collision radius is still exactly 18px.
	var incoming: Vector2=context.get("hit_direction",Vector2.ZERO)
	return incoming.is_finite() and incoming.normalized().y >= (definition as WindkeeperDefinition).upper_core_dot

func core_offset() -> Vector2:
	var raised:bool=(definition as WindkeeperDefinition).platform_trials
	return Vector2(direction*84,-140) if raised and stage_phase==3 else Vector2(direction*36,-75) if raised and stage_phase==2 else Vector2(0, -80) if stage_phase == 2 else Vector2(direction * 65, -88 if stage_phase == 3 else (8 if raised else -8))

func _ground_pattern(delta: float) -> void:
	var config := definition as WindkeeperDefinition
	if mode == &"observe" and clock <= 0:
		direction = -1 if _target.global_position.x < motor.global_position.x else 1
		_enter(&"stomp_warning" if _stomp_next else &"charge_warning", config.warning_seconds)
	elif mode == &"stomp_warning" and clock <= 0:
		_wave(-1); _wave(1)
		_stomp_next = false
		_enter(&"stomp", 0.2)
	elif mode == &"stomp" and clock <= 0:
		_enter(&"observe", 1.4)
	elif mode == &"charge_warning" and clock <= 0:
		motor.speed = config.charge_speed
		_enter(&"charge", 1.0)
	elif mode == &"charge":
		_motion_age+=delta
		if config.storm_profile: motor.speed=config.charge_speed*clampf(_motion_age/.22,.2,1)
		var limit := arena.travel_limit(motor.global_position.x, direction)
		motor.step(direction, limit, delta)
		if clock <= 0 or limit < 2:
			_enter(&"neck", config.exposed_seconds)
	elif mode == &"neck" and clock <= 0:
		_stomp_next = true
		_enter(&"observe", 1.3)

func _wave(side: int) -> void:
	_prune_attacks()
	_attack_serial += 1
	var projectile := BossProjectile.new()
	projectile.configure(definition, StringName("windkeeper-%s-%s" % [attack_epoch, _attack_serial]), Vector2(side, 0), _target, motor)
	projectile.speed = (definition as WindkeeperDefinition).stomp_speed
	_projectiles.append(projectile)
	projectile_created.emit(projectile)
	motor.get_parent().add_child(projectile)
	projectile.global_position = Vector2(motor.global_position.x + side * 85, _floor_y - 12)

func _wind_pattern(delta: float) -> void:
	var config := definition as WindkeeperDefinition
	if mode == &"observe" and clock <= 0:
		_enter(&"blade_warning", config.warning_seconds)
	elif mode == &"blade_warning" and clock <= 0:
		blade_angle = -PI / 2
		_blade_last_hit = -1
		_enter(&"blades", config.blade_period)
	elif mode == &"blades":
		if config.storm_profile and not _storm_fired:
			_storm_fired=true
			_storm_fan(_locked_aim,[-.32,0.0,.32])
		var previous_angle := blade_angle
		blade_angle += TAU * delta / config.blade_period
		var wind_region := Rect2(Vector2(arena.left_x, _floor_y - 280), Vector2(arena.right_x-arena.left_x, 350)) if config.storm_profile else Rect2(Vector2(_home_x - 110, _floor_y - 220), Vector2(220, 145))
		if _target is PlayerMotor and wind_region.has_point(_target.global_position):
			(_target as PlayerMotor).queue_local_velocity(config.crosswind_velocity if config.storm_profile else config.wind_velocity, delta)
		if _blade_sweeps_target(previous_angle, blade_angle) and _blade_last_hit != _phase_cycle:
			_blade_last_hit = _phase_cycle
			# Real swept projectile enters the same local FrameDamagePolicy consumer.
			_attack_serial += 1
			var hit := BossProjectile.new()
			hit.configure(definition, StringName("windblade-%s-%s" % [attack_epoch, _attack_serial]), Vector2.DOWN, _target, motor)
			hit.radius = 15
			hit._shape.radius = 15
			hit.speed = 40
			hit.lifetime = 0.15
			_projectiles.append(hit)
			projectile_created.emit(hit)
			motor.get_parent().add_child(hit)
			hit.global_position = _target.global_position
		if clock <= 0:
			_phase_cycle += 1
			_enter(&"back", config.exposed_seconds)
	elif mode == &"back" and clock <= 0: _enter(&"observe", 1.0)

func _chase_pattern(delta: float) -> void:
	var config := definition as WindkeeperDefinition
	var piers:Array=_platform_piers if config.platform_trials and not _platform_piers.is_empty() else [arena.left_x+95,arena.left_x+385,arena.right_x-130] if config.platform_trials else [arena.left_x + 245, arena.left_x + 510, arena.right_x - 85]
	if mode == &"observe" and clock <= 0:
		direction = int(signf(float(piers[chase_segment])-motor.global_position.x)) if config.platform_trials else 1
		if direction==0:direction=_pier_direction
		motor.speed = config.chase_speed
		_enter(&"chase", 8.0)
	elif mode == &"chase":
		var stop := float(piers[chase_segment])
		motor.step(direction, absf(stop - motor.global_position.x), delta)
		if absf(motor.global_position.x-stop)<2 or clock <= 0:
			motor.stop()
			_enter(&"pier_warning", config.pier_warning_seconds)
	elif mode == &"pier_warning" and clock <= 0:
		_enter(&"pier_impact", config.pier_impact_seconds)
		# Only the horn-sized contact volume can hurt; never the entire artwork.
		_attack_serial += 1
		var hit := BossProjectile.new()
		hit.configure(definition, StringName("pier-%s-%s" % [attack_epoch, _attack_serial]), Vector2(direction, 0), _target, motor)
		hit.radius = 12
		hit._shape.radius = 12
		hit.speed = 0
		hit.lifetime = config.pier_impact_seconds
		_projectiles.append(hit)
		projectile_created.emit(hit)
		motor.get_parent().add_child(hit)
		hit.global_position = motor.global_position + Vector2(direction * 65, -8)
	elif mode == &"pier_impact" and clock <= 0:
		_enter(&"pier_open", config.exposed_seconds if config.platform_trials else config.exposed_seconds + 1.0)
	elif mode == &"pier_open" and config.storm_profile and not _storm_fired:
		_storm_fired=true
		_storm_fan(_locked_aim,[-.22,.22])
	elif mode == &"pier_open" and clock <= 0:
		_enter(&"final_hold" if chase_segment == 2 and not config.platform_trials else &"next_pier", config.pier_recovery_seconds)
	elif mode == &"next_pier" and clock <= 0:
		if config.platform_trials and (chase_segment+_pier_direction<0 or chase_segment+_pier_direction>2): _pier_direction*=-1
		chase_segment += _pier_direction if config.platform_trials else 1
		_enter(&"observe", 1.0)
	elif mode == &"final_hold" and clock <= 0:
		_enter(&"pier_warning", config.pier_warning_seconds)

func _clear_attacks() -> void:
	attack_epoch += 1
	_rune_shots.clear()
	_prune_attacks()
	_cancel_projectiles()
	core_open = false
	if is_instance_valid(_core): _core.collision_layer = 0
	if _target is PlayerMotor: (_target as PlayerMotor).clear_local_velocity()

func cancel_pending_attacks() -> void:
	_clear_attacks()
	motor.stop()
	if active and mode not in [&"intro", &"phase_transition"]:
		_enter(&"pier_warning" if stage_phase == 3 and mode in [&"pier_warning", &"pier_impact", &"pier_open", &"final_hold"] else &"observe", 1.2)

func skip_intro() -> void:
	if active and mode == &"intro": _enter(&"observe", 1.0)

func cancel() -> void:
	_clear_attacks()
	super.cancel()

# Sweep all four thick leaf segments through their angular travel. Sampling is
# bounded by 0.035 rad (~4px at tip), including both previous and current angles.
func _blade_sweeps_target(previous: float, current: float) -> bool:
	var hub := motor.global_position + Vector2(0,-75)
	var target_shape := _target.get_node_or_null("CollisionShape2D") as CollisionShape2D
	if target_shape == null or target_shape.shape == null: return false
	var target_rect := target_shape.shape.get_rect()
	target_rect.position += target_shape.global_position
	target_rect = target_rect.grow(12)
	var samples := maxi(1, ceili(absf(current - previous) / 0.035))
	for sample: int in samples + 1:
		var angle := lerpf(previous,current,float(sample)/samples)
		for arm: int in 4:
			var start := hub + Vector2.from_angle(angle + arm * PI/2) * 15
			var end := hub + Vector2.from_angle(angle + arm * PI/2) * 115
			if target_rect.has_point(start) or target_rect.has_point(end): return true
			var corners := [target_rect.position,Vector2(target_rect.end.x,target_rect.position.y),target_rect.end,Vector2(target_rect.position.x,target_rect.end.y)]
			for edge: int in 4:
				if Geometry2D.segment_intersects_segment(start,end,corners[edge],corners[(edge+1)%4]) != null: return true
	return false

func _prune_attacks() -> void:
	var kept: Array[BossProjectile] = []
	for index: int in _projectiles.size():
		var candidate: Variant = _projectiles[index]
		if is_instance_valid(candidate) and not candidate.spent: kept.append(candidate)
	_projectiles = kept

func bind_stage_geometry(owner_module: PlatformingModule, controller: PlayerController, policy: FrameDamagePolicy, lifetime: DemoLifetime, segment: SegmentRespawn, supports: PlainsGroundSupports = null) -> WindkeeperArena:
	_platform_piers.assign([owner_module.to_global(Vector2(350,452)).x,owner_module.to_global(Vector2(640,452)).x,owner_module.to_global(Vector2(870,452)).x])
	var consumer := WindkeeperArena.new()
	add_child(consumer)
	consumer.setup(owner_module,self,controller,policy,lifetime,segment,supports)
	reward_stands.assign([owner_module.to_global(Vector2(350,452)),owner_module.to_global(Vector2(640,452)),owner_module.to_global(Vector2(870,452))])
	return consumer

func reward_stand_position() -> Vector2:
	var x := _home_x
	if stage_phase == 3 and reward_stands.size() == 3: return reward_stands[clampi(chase_segment,0,2)]
	return Vector2(x,_floor_y - 148 if stage_phase == 3 else _floor_y - 18)

func _storm_fan(point: Vector2, offsets: Array) -> void:
	var origin:=motor.global_position+Vector2(0,-100)
	var aim: Vector2=(point-origin).normalized()
	for offset: float in offsets:
		_attack_serial+=1
		var shot:=BossProjectile.new()
		shot.configure(definition,StringName("stormseed-%s-%s" % [attack_epoch,_attack_serial]),aim.rotated(offset),_target,motor)
		shot.speed=225
		shot.lifetime=2.4
		_projectiles.append(shot)
		projectile_created.emit(shot)
		motor.get_parent().add_child(shot)
		shot.global_position=origin

func combat_snapshot() -> Dictionary:
	return {"intro_duration":intro_duration,"mode":String(mode),"clock":clock,"serial":_attack_serial,"direction":direction,"stomp_next":_stomp_next,"blade_angle":blade_angle,"phase_cycle":_phase_cycle,"blade_last_hit":_blade_last_hit,"storm_fired":_storm_fired,"locked_aim":[_locked_aim.x,_locked_aim.y],"motion_age":_motion_age,"transition_target":transition_target,"pier_direction":_pier_direction,"rune_platform":rune_platform}

func restore_combat_state(data: Dictionary) -> void:
	mode=StringName(data.mode);clock=float(data.clock)
	intro_duration=float(data.get("intro_duration",(definition as WindkeeperDefinition).intro_seconds))
	_attack_serial=int(data.get("serial",0));direction=int(data.get("direction",-1))
	_stomp_next=bool(data.get("stomp_next",true));blade_angle=float(data.get("blade_angle",0))
	_phase_cycle=int(data.get("phase_cycle",0));_blade_last_hit=int(data.get("blade_last_hit",-1))
	_storm_fired=bool(data.get("storm_fired",false));_motion_age=float(data.get("motion_age",0))
	transition_target=int(data.get("transition_target",stage_phase))
	_pier_direction=int(data.get("pier_direction",1))
	rune_platform=clampi(int(data.get("rune_platform",-1)),-1,2)
	_rune_shots.clear()
	var p: Array=data.get("locked_aim",[0,0]);_locked_aim=Vector2(p[0],p[1])
	core_open=mode in [&"neck",&"back",&"pier_open"]
	if is_instance_valid(_core): _update_combat_shapes()

func register_rune_shot(session:int,shot_id:int)->void:
	if not active or stage_phase!=3 or mode!=&"pier_open" or rune_platform!=chase_segment:return
	_rune_shots["%s:%s"%[session,shot_id]]=rune_platform
	while _rune_shots.size()>32:_rune_shots.erase(_rune_shots.keys()[0])

func body_contact_enabled() -> bool:
	return super.body_contact_enabled() and mode not in [&"intro", &"phase_transition"]

func presentation_state() -> BossPresentationState:
	var values := _presentation_values()
	values.merge({"phase":stage_phase,"phase_axes":{"combat":stage_phase},"damage_model":&"continuous_body" if continuous_combat() else &"aperture","core_hint_visible":core_open},true)
	var config := definition as WindkeeperDefinition
	var duration := config.pier_warning_seconds if mode == &"pier_warning" else config.phase_warning_seconds if mode == &"phase_transition" else config.warning_seconds
	return _presentation_countdown(values,mode,clock,duration,mode in [&"stomp_warning",&"charge_warning",&"blade_warning",&"pier_warning",&"phase_transition"],mode in [&"stomp",&"pier_impact"],mode in [&"charge",&"chase",&"blades"],mode in [&"neck",&"back",&"pier_open",&"final_hold"])

func presentation_capabilities() -> PackedStringArray:
	return PackedStringArray(["core_anchor","wind_arena","combat_state"])

func presentation_intro() -> Dictionary:
	var duration := maxf(intro_duration if intro_duration > 0 else (definition as WindkeeperDefinition).intro_seconds,.01)
	return {"active":active and mode == &"intro","duration":duration,"raw_clock":clock,"progress":clampf(1.0-clock/duration,0.0,1.0),"direction":direction}

func presentation_core() -> Dictionary:
	# Exposure is a UI hint, not permission to damage the body or core.
	return {"visible":core_open,"offset":core_offset(),"raw_clock":clock,"remaining_fraction":clampf(clock/(definition as WindkeeperDefinition).exposed_seconds,0.0,1.0),"continuous_combat":continuous_combat()}

func presentation_rune_cue() -> Dictionary:
	if continuous_combat() or not (definition as WindkeeperDefinition).platform_trials or stage_phase != 3 or not active or _platform_piers.size() != 3: return {}
	return {"position":Vector2(_platform_piers[clampi(chase_segment,0,2)],_floor_y-155),"charged":rune_platform == chase_segment}

func presentation_locked_aim() -> Dictionary:
	if not (definition as WindkeeperDefinition).storm_profile or mode not in [&"blade_warning",&"pier_warning"]: return {}
	return {"position":_locked_aim}

func presentation_blades() -> Dictionary:
	return {"angle":blade_angle,"active":stage_phase == 2 and mode == &"blades"}

class_name BellstriderEncounter
extends WindkeeperEncounter
## Encounter-owned clock, immutable selected groups, and shared articulated rig.
## Damage statistics observe accepted Health transactions and never choose states.
var pattern_index := 0  # Completed groups, retained for existing observers.
var locked_point := Vector2.ZERO
var volley := 0
var _roll_age := 0.0
var _rng := RandomNumberGenerator.new()
var _group: Dictionary = {}
var _recent_groups: Array[StringName] = []
var _fight_age := 0.0

func _config() -> BellstriderDefinition:
	return definition as BellstriderDefinition


func _ready() -> void:
	super._ready()
	if _config() == null:
		push_error("Bellstrider requires BellstriderDefinition")
		return
	var shape := _core.get_child(0) as CollisionShape2D
	var rectangle := RectangleShape2D.new()
	rectangle.size = Vector2(30, 36)
	shape.shape = rectangle
	# The bevel above the copper nose is real clear air for ground diagonals.
	# A full140x70 box intercepted visible paths to the exposed upper bell.
	var hull := motor.get_node("CollisionShape2D") as CollisionShape2D
	var polygon := ConvexPolygonShape2D.new()
	polygon.points = PackedVector2Array(BellstriderRigPose.HULL_POINTS)
	hull.shape = polygon
	_hull_rig_ready = true
	for side: int in [-1, 1]:
		var wheel := CollisionShape2D.new()
		wheel.name = "BellArmourLeftWheel" if side < 0 else "BellArmourRightWheel"
		var circle := CircleShape2D.new()
		circle.radius = BellstriderRigPose.WHEEL_RADIUS
		wheel.shape = circle
		motor.add_child.call_deferred(wheel)
		_armour_wheels.append(wheel)
	_core.add_to_group(&"grapple_target")
	health.changed.connect(_health_changed)
	armour_hit.connect(_armour_feedback)
	_update_combat_shapes()


func configure_arena(left: float, right: float, target: Node2D) -> bool:
	if _config() == null or not super.configure_arena(left, right, target):
		return false
	_rng.seed = _config().selection_seed ^ int(roundf(left)) ^ (int(roundf(right)) * 31)
	_camp_anchor = target.global_position
	return true


func activate() -> bool:
	if _config() == null or not super.activate():
		return false
	pattern_index = 0
	_group.clear()
	_recent_groups.clear()
	_fight_age = 0.0
	_travel = 0.0
	_camp_age = 0.0
	_camp_anchor = _target.global_position
	_death_age = 0.0
	_death_jammed = false
	_death_impacted = false
	_death_finished = false
	_update_combat_shapes()
	return true


func weakpoint_only() -> bool:
	return true


func reward_impact_delay() -> float:
	return _config().reward_impact_seconds


func reward_impact_ready() -> bool:
	return health.terminal and _death_impacted


func prepare_terminal_restore() -> void:
	# Region loading restores Health before it has the bound player/arena needed
	# for the complete combat snapshot. Suppress a new death transition during
	# that reconstruction; the subsequent restore resumes the saved failure pose.
	active = false
	mode = &"dead"
	motor.stop()
	motor.collision_layer = 0
	motor.collision_mask = 0
	_update_combat_shapes()


func core_offset() -> Vector2:
	var transform: Transform2D = rig_pose().get("bell_transform", Transform2D.IDENTITY)
	return transform.origin


func rig_pose() -> Dictionary:
	return BellstriderRigPose.sample(_rig_inputs())


func _rig_inputs() -> Dictionary:
	return {
		"mode": mode,
		"phase": stage_phase,
		"direction": direction,
		"fight_age": _fight_age,
		"state_age": _state_age,
		"state_duration": _state_duration,
		"warning_progress": _warning_progress(),
		"speed": motor.velocity.x if is_instance_valid(motor) else 0.0,
		"travel": _travel,
		"combo": bool(_group.get("return_roll", false)),
		"combo_index": int(_group.get("roll_index", 0)),
		"recovery_progress":
		clampf(_state_age / maxf(.01, _state_duration), 0.0, 1.0) if mode == &"neck" else 0.0,
		"ring_strike_age": _ring_strike_age,
		"bell_hit_age": _bell_hit_age,
		"armour_hit_age": _armour_hit_age,
		"death_age": _death_age,
		"death_duration": _config().death_seconds if _config() != null else 1.8,
		"transition_from": _transition_from,
		"recovery_from": _recovery_from,
		"launcher_aim": _launcher_aim
	}


func _warning_progress() -> float:
	return (
		clampf(_state_age / maxf(.01, _state_duration), 0.0, 1.0)
		if (
			mode
			in [
				&"roll_warning",
				&"combo_warning",
				&"ring_warning",
				&"lob_aim",
				&"lob_lock",
				&"phase_transition"
			]
		)
		else 0.0
	)


func _update_combat_shapes() -> void:
	if not is_instance_valid(_core) or not is_instance_valid(motor):
		return
	var pose := rig_pose()
	if _hull_rig_ready:
		(motor.get_node("CollisionShape2D") as CollisionShape2D).transform = pose.body_transform
		if is_instance_valid(_contact_shape):
			_contact_shape.transform = (
				pose.body_transform * Transform2D(0, _config().contact_offset)
			)
		for index: int in _armour_wheels.size():
			_armour_wheels[index].transform = pose.left_wheel if index == 0 else pose.right_wheel
	_core.transform = pose.get("bell_transform", Transform2D.IDENTITY)
	var shape := _core.get_child(0) as CollisionShape2D
	if shape.shape is RectangleShape2D:
		var rectangle := shape.shape as RectangleShape2D
		var size: Vector2 = pose.get("weak_size", Vector2(30, 36))
		if rectangle.size != size:
			rectangle.size = size
	_core.collision_layer = 4 if accepts_combat_damage() else 0
	# Only this low armour hull blocks shots. The raised bell is its own Area.
	motor.collision_layer = 4 if accepts_combat_damage() else 0

func _capture_transition() -> void:
	var pose := rig_pose()
	_transition_from.clear()
	for key: String in [
		"body_transform",
		"mast_transform",
		"bell_transform",
		"launcher_transform",
		"left_wheel",
		"right_wheel",
		"panel_angle",
		"clapper_angle"
	]:
		if pose.has(key):
			_transition_from[key] = pose[key]
	_transition_prepared = true


func _enter(next: StringName, duration: float) -> void:
	if not _transition_prepared:
		_capture_transition()
	_transition_prepared = false
	if not _state_history.is_empty():
		_state_history[-1]["end"] = _fight_age
	super._enter(next, duration)
	_state_age = 0.0
	_state_duration = duration
	_state_history.append(
		{"mode": String(next), "start": _fight_age, "duration": duration, "group": _groups_started}
	)
	if _state_history.size() > 256:
		_state_history.pop_front()
	match next:
		&"roll_warning", &"combo_warning":
			_event(
				&"bellstrider_roll_warn",
				{
					"combo": bool(_group.get("return_roll", false)),
					"index": int(_group.get("roll_index", 0))
				}
			)
		&"roll":
			_event(&"bellstrider_roll_start")
		&"combo_brake":
			_event(&"bellstrider_brake", {"final": false})
		&"combo_turn":
			_event(&"bellstrider_turn")
		&"lob_aim":
			_event(&"bellstrider_lob_aim")
		&"lob_lock":
			_event(&"bellstrider_lob_lock", {"point": locked_point})
		&"neck":
			_event(&"bellstrider_brake", {"final": true})
		&"phase_transition":
			_event(&"bellstrider_phase")


func physics_tick(delta: float) -> void:
	if delta <= 0.0 or not is_finite(delta):
		return
	if mode == &"dead":
		_advance_death(delta)
		return
	_prune_attacks()
	if not active or health.terminal or not is_instance_valid(_target):
		return
	_fight_age += delta
	_state_age += delta
	_ring_strike_age += delta
	_bell_hit_age += delta
	_armour_hit_age += delta
	clock -= delta
	if stage_phase == 1 and health.current <= health.capacity * _config().phase_two_health:
		_phase_pending = true
	if _phase_pending and mode == &"approach" and _group.is_empty():
		_start_phase_two()
	if _target.global_position.distance_to(_camp_anchor) > _config().camping_radius:
		_camp_anchor = _target.global_position
		_camp_age = 0.0
	else:
		_camp_age += delta
	var before := motor.global_position.x
	match mode:
		&"intro":
			if clock <= 0.0:
				_enter(&"observe", _config().observe_seconds)
		&"observe":
			if clock <= 0.0:
				if _phase_pending:
					_start_phase_two()
				else:
					_select_group()
		&"approach":
			motor.speed = move_toward(
				absf(motor.velocity.x),
				_config().chase_speed,
				_config().chase_speed / _config().roll_acceleration_seconds * delta
			)
			var limit := arena.travel_limit(motor.global_position.x, direction)
			motor.step(direction, limit, delta)
			if (
				limit <= .01
				or (
					absf(_target.global_position.x - motor.global_position.x)
					<= _config().approach_distance * .85
				)
			):
				motor.stop()
				if _phase_pending:
					_start_phase_two()
				else:
					_select_group()
		&"roll_warning", &"combo_warning":
			if clock <= 0.0:
				_roll_age = 0.0
				_enter(&"roll", _config().roll_max_seconds)
		&"roll":
			_roll_age += delta
			var charge := (
				_config().phase_two_charge_speed
				if int(_group.get("phase", 1)) == 2
				else _config().charge_speed
			)
			motor.speed = charge * clampf(_roll_age / _config().roll_acceleration_seconds, 0.0, 1.0)
			var limit := arena.travel_limit(motor.global_position.x, direction)
			motor.step(direction, limit, delta)
			if clock <= 0.0 or limit <= motor.speed * delta + .01:
				motor.stop()
				if bool(_group.get("return_roll", false)) and int(_group.get("roll_index", 0)) == 0:
					_enter(&"combo_brake", _config().combo_brake_seconds)
				else:
					_cool_down()
		&"combo_brake":
			if clock <= 0.0:
				_capture_transition()
				direction *= -1
				_group["roll_index"] = 1
				_enter(&"combo_turn", _config().combo_turn_seconds)
		&"combo_turn":
			if clock <= 0.0:
				_enter(&"combo_warning", _config().combo_warning_seconds)
		&"ring_warning":
			if clock <= 0.0:
				_ring_pair()
				volley += 1
				_enter(
					&"rings",
					(
						_config().ring_interval_seconds
						if volley < int(_group.get("count", 1))
						else _config().ring_settle_seconds
					)
				)
		&"rings":
			if clock <= 0.0:
				if volley < int(_group.get("count", 1)):
					_ring_pair()
					volley += 1
					_enter(&"rings", _config().ring_settle_seconds)
				else:
					_cool_down()
		&"lob_aim":
			locked_point = _landing_for_target()
			_aim_launcher(locked_point)
			if clock <= 0.0:
				_enter(&"lob_lock", _config().lob_lock_seconds)
		&"lob_lock":
			if clock <= 0.0:
				_launch(locked_point)
				volley += 1
				_enter(&"lob", lob_duration_for(locked_point) + _config().lob_followup_seconds)
		&"lob":
			if clock <= 0.0:
				if volley < int(_group.get("count", 1)):
					_enter(&"lob_aim", _config().lob_aim_seconds)
				else:
					_cool_down()
		&"neck":
			if clock <= 0.0:
				_groups_completed += 1
				pattern_index += 1
				_history.append(
					{
						"group": _groups_started,
						"kind": _group.get("kind", &""),
						"end": _fight_age,
						"recovery_start": _fight_age - _state_age,
						"recovery_seconds": _state_age
					}
				)
				if _history.size() > 128:
					_history.pop_front()
				_group.clear()
				_enter(&"observe", _config().observe_seconds)
		&"phase_transition":
			if clock <= 0.0:
				_enter(&"observe", _config().observe_seconds)
	_travel += motor.global_position.x - before
	_update_combat_shapes()
	motor.queue_redraw()


func _start_phase_two() -> void:
	# Never interrupts or changes a selected group, including its projectiles.
	_phase_pending = false
	stage_phase = 2
	motor.stop()
	phase_changed.emit(2)
	_enter(&"phase_transition", _config().phase_warning_seconds)


func selection_weights() -> Dictionary:
	var dx := absf(_target.global_position.x - motor.global_position.x)
	var elevation := _floor_y - (_target.global_position.y + 18.0)
	var high := elevation >= _config().elevated_height
	var near := dx < _config().near_distance
	var camping := _camp_age >= _config().camping_seconds
	var weights := {
		&"roll": 3.6 if dx > _config().near_distance else 1.0,
		&"ring": 3.8 if near and not high else 1.0,
		&"lob": 4.0 if high else 1.0
	}
	if camping:
		weights[&"lob"] = float(weights[&"lob"]) + 2.6
	# A charge begins outside contact and needs actual acceleration/braking room.
	# At an edge/point-blank start select another complete group, never an
	# instantaneous dash or a warning whose real trajectory is impossible.
	var side := 1 if _target.global_position.x >= motor.global_position.x else -1
	if (
		dx < _config().minimum_roll_start_distance
		or arena.travel_limit(motor.global_position.x, side) < _config().minimum_roll_travel
	):
		weights[&"roll"] = 0.0
	for index: int in _recent_groups.size():
		var kind: StringName = _recent_groups[index]
		weights[kind] = (
			float(weights[kind])
			* pow(_config().recent_group_penalty, float(index + 1) / float(_recent_groups.size()))
		)
	if _recent_groups.size() >= _config().max_group_repeats:
		var last := _recent_groups[-1]
		var repeated := true
		for index: int in _config().max_group_repeats:
			if _recent_groups[-1 - index] != last:
				repeated = false
		if repeated:
			weights[last] = 0.0
	return weights


func _select_group() -> void:
	# Close the distance before choosing a committed attack, regardless of which
	# random group will follow. This prelude never spends RNG or an attack group.
	if absf(_target.global_position.x - motor.global_position.x) > _config().approach_distance:
		_capture_transition()
		direction = 1 if _target.global_position.x >= motor.global_position.x else -1
		_enter(&"approach", _config().approach_seconds)
		return
	var weights := selection_weights()
	var total := float(weights[&"roll"]) + float(weights[&"ring"]) + float(weights[&"lob"])
	var pick := _rng.randf() * total
	var chosen: StringName = &"lob"
	for kind: StringName in [&"roll", &"ring", &"lob"]:
		pick -= float(weights[kind])
		if pick < 0.0:
			chosen = kind
			break
	_capture_transition()
	direction = 1 if _target.global_position.x >= motor.global_position.x else -1
	# Every random group property is fixed before any attack warning starts.
	_group = {
		"kind": chosen,
		"phase": stage_phase,
		"direction": direction,
		"return_roll":
		chosen == &"roll" and stage_phase == 2 and _rng.randf() < _config().return_roll_chance,
		# Every random group property is fixed before any attack warning starts.
		"roll_index": 0,
		"count": 2 if stage_phase == 2 and chosen != &"roll" else 1,
		"selected_at": _fight_age,
		"weights": weights.duplicate(true)
	}
	_recent_groups.append(chosen)
	if _recent_groups.size() > 4:
		_recent_groups.pop_front()
	_groups_started += 1
	volley = 0
	_event(&"bellstrider_group", {"plan": _group.duplicate(true), "group": _groups_started})
	_start_group_warning()


func _start_group_warning() -> void:
	motor.stop()
	match StringName(_group.get("kind", &"roll")):
		&"roll":
			_enter(&"roll_warning", _config().roll_warning_seconds)
		&"ring":
			_enter(&"ring_warning", _config().ring_warning_seconds)
		&"lob":
			locked_point = _landing_for_target()
			_enter(&"lob_aim", _config().lob_aim_seconds)


func _cool_down() -> void:
	_recovery_from = mode
	motor.stop()
	_enter(&"neck", _config().exposed_seconds)


func _ring_pair() -> void:
	_ring_strike_age = 0.0
	_event(
		&"bellstrider_ring_strike",
		{"wave": volley + 1, "point": Vector2(motor.global_position.x, _floor_y)}
	)
	for side: int in [-1, 1]:
		var shot := BellstriderRingProjectile.new()
		_configure_projectile(shot, &"bellstrider_ring", Vector2(side, 0))
		shot.speed = _config().ring_speed
		shot.radius = _config().ring_radius
		shot._shape.radius = shot.radius
		shot.lifetime = _config().ring_lifetime
		shot.global_position = Vector2(
			motor.global_position.x + side * 74, _floor_y - shot.radius - 2
		)


func _configure_projectile(shot: BossProjectile, kind: StringName, aim: Vector2) -> void:
	_attack_serial += 1
	shot.configure(
		definition,
		StringName("%s-%s-%s" % [kind, attack_epoch, _attack_serial]),
		aim,
		_target,
		motor
	)
	shot.set_meta(&"item_v5_world_entity", true)
	if shot.has_method("bind_attack"):
		shot.call("bind_attack", self, attack_epoch)
	_projectiles.append(shot)
	projectile_created.emit(shot)
	motor.get_parent().add_child(shot)


func _landing_for_target() -> Vector2:
	# BossArena limits its centre by the large chassis half-width. A player can
	# stand closer to the seals, so targeting must use the actual player x.
	var feet := _target.global_position + Vector2(0, 18)
	var excluded: Array[RID] = [motor.get_rid()]
	if _target is CollisionObject2D:
		excluded.append((_target as CollisionObject2D).get_rid())
	# A jumping player above a gap still receives a mark on real nearby ground.
	# The final candidate is the supported machine itself, never a fake plane.
	var candidates: Array[Vector2] = []
	for offset: float in [0.0, -32.0, 32.0, -64.0, 64.0, -128.0, 128.0]:
		candidates.append(feet + Vector2(offset, -2))
	candidates.append(motor.global_position)
	for candidate: Vector2 in candidates:
		var query := PhysicsRayQueryParameters2D.create(
			candidate, Vector2(candidate.x, maxf(_floor_y + 160, candidate.y + 800)), 1
		)
		query.exclude = excluded
		var result := motor.get_world_2d().direct_space_state.intersect_ray(query)
		if not result.is_empty():
			return result.position
	# Invalid arena geometry cannot create a remote invisible ground shock.
	return motor.global_position


func _aim_launcher(point: Vector2) -> void:
	# Match the visible barrel to the actual ballistic launch velocity. Solve
	# twice because the muzzle moves with the elevation; tracking stops at lock.
	var body: Transform2D = rig_pose().body_transform
	var duration := lob_duration_for(point)
	for index: int in 2:
		var mount := body * Transform2D(_launcher_aim, Vector2(43, 4))
		var origin := motor.to_global(mount * Vector2(25, -3))
		var initial := (
			(point - origin) / duration - Vector2(0, _config().lob_gravity * duration * .5)
		)
		_launcher_aim = clampf(body.basis_xform_inv(initial).angle(), -PI + .18, -.18)


func lob_duration_for(point: Vector2) -> float:
	# A lower landing needs a steeper descending leg to clear nearby shelf
	# corners. Raised targets keep a shorter arc within the normal camera view.
	return (
		_config().lob_lower_flight_seconds
		if point.y > motor.global_position.y + 10.0
		else _config().lob_flight_seconds
	)


func _launch(point: Vector2) -> void:
	var shot := BellstriderBellProjectile.new()
	var pose := rig_pose()
	var launcher: Transform2D = pose.get("launcher_transform", Transform2D(0, Vector2(34, -34)))
	_configure_projectile(shot, &"bellstrider_lob", (point - motor.global_position).normalized())
	shot.global_position = motor.to_global(launcher * Vector2(25, -3))
	shot.gravity = _config().lob_gravity
	var duration := lob_duration_for(point)
	shot.lifetime = duration + 1.5
	shot.aim_landing(point, duration)
	var epoch := attack_epoch
	shot.impacted.connect(
		func(surface: Vector2, normal: Vector2) -> void: _lob_impact(surface, normal, epoch)
	)
	_event(
		&"bellstrider_lob_release",
		{"point": point, "origin": shot.global_position, "volley": volley + 1}
	)


func _lob_impact(point: Vector2, normal: Vector2, epoch: int) -> void:
	if not active or health.terminal or epoch != attack_epoch:
		_cancelled_callbacks += 1
		return
	_event(&"bellstrider_lob_impact", {"point": point, "normal": normal})
	# One bounded stationary shock, aligned with the actual hit surface.
	var shot := BellstriderRingProjectile.new()
	_configure_projectile(shot, &"bellstrider_local_ring", Vector2.ZERO)
	shot.speed = 0.0

func _event(id: StringName, extra: Dictionary = {}) -> void:
	var row := {
		"event": id,
		"age": _fight_age,
		"position": motor.global_position if is_instance_valid(motor) else Vector2.ZERO,
		"phase": stage_phase,
		"direction": direction,
		"mode": mode,
		"group": _groups_started
	}
	row.merge(extra, true)
	_event_history.append(row.duplicate(true))
	if _event_history.size() > 256:
		_event_history.pop_front()
	presentation_event.emit(row)


func _health_changed(result: ActorResourceResult) -> void:
	if (
		result.operation != &"damage"
		or result.status != ActorResourceResult.Status.APPLIED
		or result.amount_applied >= 0.0
	):
		return
	_accepted_hits += 1
	_accepted_damage -= result.amount_applied
	_bell_hit_age = 0.0
	_update_combat_shapes()
	_event(
		&"bellstrider_bell_hit",
		{
			"amount": -result.amount_applied,
			"event_id": result.event_id,
			"health": health.current,
			"point": motor.to_global(core_offset())
		}
	)


func _armour_feedback(point: Vector2) -> void:

	_update_combat_shapes()

func body_contact_rect() -> Rect2:
	# Include the installed bell as well as armour. Receiving weapon damage and
	# dealing player contact damage are separate capabilities of the same bell.
	# Narrow admission below still preserves the open space around the mast.
	var hull := motor.get_node("CollisionShape2D") as CollisionShape2D
	var bounds := hull.global_transform * hull.shape.get_rect()
	for wheel: CollisionShape2D in _armour_wheels:
		if is_instance_valid(wheel) and wheel.is_inside_tree():
			bounds = bounds.merge(wheel.global_transform * wheel.shape.get_rect())
	var bell := _core.get_child(0) as CollisionShape2D
	bounds = bounds.merge(bell.global_transform * bell.shape.get_rect())
	return bounds


func body_contact_sweep(source_center: Vector2, previous_relative: Vector2, current_world: Vector2, actor_half: Vector2) -> bool:
	if not body_contact_enabled() or not source_center.is_finite() or not previous_relative.is_finite() or not current_world.is_finite() or not actor_half.is_finite() or actor_half.x<=0.0 or actor_half.y<=0.0:
		return false
	var start := source_center + previous_relative
	var motion := current_world - start
	var size := actor_half * 2.0
	if _contact_actor_box.size != size: _contact_actor_box.size = size
	var actor_transform := Transform2D(0,start)
	var hull := motor.get_node("CollisionShape2D") as CollisionShape2D
	if _contact_actor_box.collide_with_motion(actor_transform,motion,hull.shape,hull.global_transform,Vector2.ZERO):
		return true
	for wheel: CollisionShape2D in _armour_wheels:
		if is_instance_valid(wheel) and wheel.is_inside_tree() and _contact_actor_box.collide_with_motion(actor_transform,motion,wheel.shape,wheel.global_transform,Vector2.ZERO):
			return true
	var bell := _core.get_child(0) as CollisionShape2D
	if _contact_actor_box.collide_with_motion(actor_transform, motion, bell.shape, bell.global_transform, Vector2.ZERO):
		return true
	return false


func body_contact_enabled() -> bool:
	# Transition pressure still has real solid copper. Only intro, inactivity
	# and terminal wrecks suppress contact; the base Windkeeper window differs.
	return active and not health.terminal and mode not in [&"intro",&"dead"]


func cancel_pending_attacks() -> void:
	_clear_attacks()
	_event(&"bellstrider_audio_cancel")
	motor.stop()
	_group.clear()
	if active and mode != &"intro":
		_enter(&"observe", _config().observe_seconds)
	_update_combat_shapes()


func cancel() -> void:
	super.cancel()

func _on_defeat() -> void:
	if mode == &"dead":
		return
	# Preserve the existing one-shot defeated signal and FrameDamagePolicy owner.
	# Death pose has its own bounded clock after active/contact are disabled.
	_clear_attacks()
	_event(&"bellstrider_audio_cancel")
	active = false
	motor.stop()
	motor.collision_layer = 0
	motor.collision_mask = 0
	_death_age = 0.0
	_enter(&"dead", _config().death_seconds)
	_event(&"bellstrider_death")
	_update_combat_shapes()
	defeated.emit(self)


func _advance_death(delta: float) -> void:
	var previous := _death_age
	_death_age = minf(_config().death_seconds, _death_age + delta)
	_fight_age += _death_age - previous
	_state_age = _death_age
	clock = maxf(0.0, _config().death_seconds - _death_age)
	if not _death_jammed and _death_age >= .38:
		_death_jammed = true
		_event(&"bellstrider_death_jam")
	if not _death_impacted and _death_age >= _config().reward_impact_seconds:
		_death_impacted = true
		_event(&"bellstrider_death_impact")
	if not _death_finished and _death_age >= _config().death_seconds:
		_death_finished = true
		_event(&"bellstrider_death_final")
	_update_combat_shapes()
	motor.queue_redraw()


func combat_metrics() -> Dictionary:
	return {
		"fight_seconds": _fight_age,

		"cancelled_callbacks": _cancelled_callbacks,

		"states": _state_history.duplicate(true),
		"events": _event_history.duplicate(true)
	}


func combat_snapshot() -> Dictionary:
	var data := super.combat_snapshot()
	data.merge(
		{
			"pattern_index": pattern_index,
			"locked_point": [locked_point.x, locked_point.y],
			"volley": volley,
			"roll_age": _roll_age,
			"stage_phase": stage_phase,
			"rng_state": str(_rng.state),
			"group": _group.duplicate(true),
			"recent_groups": _recent_groups.duplicate(),
			"fight_age": _fight_age,
			"state_age": _state_age,
			"state_duration": _state_duration,
			"travel": _travel,
			"camp_age": _camp_age,
			"camp_anchor": [_camp_anchor.x, _camp_anchor.y],
			"phase_pending": _phase_pending,
			"ring_strike_age": _ring_strike_age,
			"bell_hit_age": _bell_hit_age,
			"armour_hit_age": _armour_hit_age,
			"death_age": _death_age,
			"death_jammed": _death_jammed,
			"death_impacted": _death_impacted,
			"death_finished": _death_finished,
			"accepted_hits": _accepted_hits,
			"accepted_damage": _accepted_damage,
			"groups_started": _groups_started,
			"groups_completed": _groups_completed,
			"recovery_from": String(_recovery_from),
			"launcher_aim": _launcher_aim,
			"transition_from": _transition_snapshot()
		},
		true
	)
	return data


func restore_combat_state(data: Dictionary) -> void:
	# Existing callbacks cannot survive an in-place restore of the same actor.
	_clear_attacks()
	_event(&"bellstrider_audio_cancel")
	super.restore_combat_state(data)
	pattern_index = int(data.get("pattern_index", 0))
	volley = int(data.get("volley", 0))
	_roll_age = float(data.get("roll_age", 0))
	stage_phase = int(data.get("stage_phase", 1))
	if data.has("rng_state"):
		_rng.state = int(str(data.rng_state))
	_group = _restored_group(data.get("group", {}))
	_recent_groups.clear()
	for kind: Variant in data.get("recent_groups", []):
		_recent_groups.append(StringName(kind))
	_fight_age = float(data.get("fight_age", 0))
	_state_age = float(data.get("state_age", 0))
	_state_duration = float(data.get("state_duration", clock))
	_travel = float(data.get("travel", 0))
	_camp_age = float(data.get("camp_age", 0))
	var p: Array = data.get("locked_point", [0, 0])
	locked_point = Vector2(p[0], p[1])
	p = data.get("camp_anchor", [0, 0])
	_camp_anchor = Vector2(p[0], p[1])
	_phase_pending = bool(data.get("phase_pending", false))
	_ring_strike_age = float(data.get("ring_strike_age", 99))
	_bell_hit_age = float(data.get("bell_hit_age", 99))
	_armour_hit_age = float(data.get("armour_hit_age", 99))
	_death_age = float(data.get("death_age", 0))
	_death_jammed = bool(data.get("death_jammed", false))
	_death_impacted = bool(data.get("death_impacted", false))
	_death_finished = bool(data.get("death_finished", false))
	_accepted_hits = int(data.get("accepted_hits", 0))
	_accepted_damage = float(data.get("accepted_damage", 0))
	_groups_started = int(data.get("groups_started", 0))
	_groups_completed = int(data.get("groups_completed", 0))
	_recovery_from = StringName(data.get("recovery_from", &"roll"))
	_launcher_aim = float(data.get("launcher_aim", -.82))
	_restore_transition(data.get("transition_from", {}))
	_transition_prepared = false
	if mode == &"dead" or health.terminal:
		active = false
	# No delayed closures or projectiles are reconstructed by a stage snapshot.
	# A resumed group retains its exact plan; callbacks belong to the new epoch.
	_update_combat_shapes()


func _restored_group(data: Dictionary) -> Dictionary:
	# JSON carries neither StringName identity nor integer numeric tags. Restore
	# the announced plan's original types as well as its values; never redraw it.
	var result := data.duplicate(true)
	if result.has("kind"):
		result["kind"] = StringName(result.kind)
	for key: String in ["phase", "direction", "count", "roll_index"]:
		if result.has(key):
			result[key] = int(result[key])
	if result.has("return_roll"):
		result["return_roll"] = bool(result.return_roll)
	if result.has("selected_at"):
		result["selected_at"] = float(result.selected_at)
	if result.has("weights"):
		var weights: Dictionary = {}
		for key: Variant in result.weights:
			weights[StringName(key)] = float(result.weights[key])
		result["weights"] = weights
	return result


func _transition_snapshot() -> Dictionary:
	var result: Dictionary = {}
	for key: String in _transition_from:
		var value: Variant = _transition_from[key]
		if value is Transform2D:
			var transform: Transform2D = value
			result[key] = [
				transform.x.x,
				transform.x.y,
				transform.y.x,
				transform.y.y,
				transform.origin.x,
				transform.origin.y
			]
		else:
			result[key] = value
	return result


func _restore_transition(data: Dictionary) -> void:
	_transition_from.clear()
	for key: String in data:
		var value: Variant = data[key]
		if value is Array and value.size() == 6:
			_transition_from[key] = Transform2D(
				Vector2(value[0], value[1]),
				Vector2(value[2], value[3]),
				Vector2(value[4], value[5])
			)
		elif value is float or value is int:
			_transition_from[key] = value


func presentation_state() -> BossPresentationState:
	var values := _presentation_values()
	values.merge(
		{
			"phase": stage_phase,
			"phase_axes": {"combat": stage_phase},
			"damage_model": &"upper_bell_only",
			"core_hint_visible": false,
			"rig": rig_pose(),
			"group": _group.duplicate(true)
		},
		true
	)
	return _presentation_countdown(
		values,
		mode,
		clock,
		_state_duration,
		(
			mode
			in [
				&"roll_warning",
				&"combo_warning",
				&"ring_warning",
				&"lob_aim",
				&"lob_lock",
				&"phase_transition"
			]
		),
		mode in [&"rings", &"lob"],
		mode in [&"roll", &"approach"],
		mode == &"neck"
	)


func presentation_core() -> Dictionary:
	return {
		"visible": false,
		"offset": core_offset(),
		"raw_clock": clock,
		"remaining_fraction": clampf(clock / maxf(.01, _state_duration), 0.0, 1.0),
		"continuous_combat": true,
		"weakpoint_only": true
	}


func presentation_locked_aim() -> Dictionary:
	return (
		{"position": locked_point, "locked": mode == &"lob_lock"}
		if mode in [&"lob_aim", &"lob_lock"]
		else {}
	)


func presentation_capabilities() -> PackedStringArray:
	return PackedStringArray(
		["core_anchor", "locked_lob", "combat_state", "articulated_rig", "weakpoint_only"]
	)


func roll_warning_distance() -> float:
	var speed := (
		_config().phase_two_charge_speed
		if int(_group.get("phase", stage_phase)) == 2
		else _config().charge_speed
	)
	return (
		minf(
			arena.travel_limit(motor.global_position.x, direction),
			speed * (_config().roll_max_seconds - _config().roll_acceleration_seconds * .5)
		)
		+ _config().contact_size.x * .5
	)

func _explicit_plains_candidate() -> bool:
	return spatial_golden_requested or plains_environment_candidate_requested or plains_regional_art_candidate_requested or bool(get_meta("plains_world_rebuild_candidate",false))

func start_plains(seed_value: String = "plains-run") -> bool:
	_debug_region = &""
	return start_demo(seed_value, true)

func start_debug_region(region: StringName, map_index: int, seed_value: String, content_version: String = "", layout_version: String = "") -> bool:
	if region not in [&"plains", &"thorn_forest"] or map_index not in [1,2]: return false
	if not content_version.is_empty() and (region != &"thorn_forest" or not ThornForestRegionGenerator.supported(content_version)): return false
	if not layout_version.is_empty() and (region != &"thorn_forest" or content_version != ThornForestRegionGenerator.DEPTH_VERSION or not ThornForestRegionGenerator.DEPTH_LAYOUT_SCRIPTS.has(layout_version)): return false
	# Rejected entries must not replace the next run's region/version request.
	if director.state != DemoRunDirector.State.HOME or seed_value.is_empty() or is_instance_valid(_lab) or is_instance_valid(_preview) or is_instance_valid(_foundry) or is_instance_valid(_style_lab): return false
	_debug_region = region
	_debug_map = map_index
	_requested_forest_version = content_version
	_requested_forest_layout = layout_version
	var accepted := start_demo(seed_value,true)
	if accepted: print("FOREST_UI_EVENT " + JSON.stringify({"event":"debug_entry","region":String(region),"map_index":map_index,"seed":seed_value,"natural_progression":false}))
	return accepted

func _region_seed() -> String:

	return "%s/map_%s/" % [active_region_id,director.region_map_index]

func _region_name() -> String:

func _pixel_projectiles(_direction: Vector2, _shot_id: int) -> void:
	if not is_instance_valid(controller) or not _uses_pixel_plains_presentation(): return
	for projectile: PlayerProjectile in controller.shoot_ability.get_projectiles():
		if is_instance_valid(projectile.presentation):continue
		var visual := PixelPlainsProjectile.new()
		visual.projectile = projectile
		projectile.presentation = visual
		projectile.add_child(visual)

	var selected_home_item := StringName(meta.snapshot().get("selected_home_item", ""))

	active_region_id = _debug_region if region_map and not _debug_region.is_empty() else &"plains"
	forest_content_version = _requested_forest_version if not _requested_forest_version.is_empty() else ThornForestRegionGenerator.VERSION
	_forest_layout_version = _requested_forest_layout if not _requested_forest_layout.is_empty() else ThornForestRegionGenerator.CURRENT_DEPTH_LAYOUT

	_requested_forest_version = ""
	_requested_forest_layout = ""

	connected_region = region_map

	_region_chest = -1
	_region_offer = null

		return false

	if not RunComposition.configure_capabilities(controller, connected_region, active_region_id == &"thorn_forest"): return false
	controller.interact_requested.connect(interact)

	overlay = InputSetup.attach_menu(player, controller.router, toggle_pause, "MENU")

		controller.actor_resources.health_definition = meta.fresh_health_definition(controller.actor_resources.health_definition)
		controller.actor_resources.health.configure(controller.actor_resources.health_definition)
	run_session.create_run_services(&"plains" if connected_region else director.biome_id, connected_region)

	_input_revision = 0

	_hud_frame.show()
	_pause_button.show()

	if started and connected_region:
		_grant_home_carry()

func _stage_entered(_result: DemoRunResult) -> void:
	_close_build_session()
	if _item_runtime != null: _item_runtime.before_stage_change()
	if campaign.debug_entry and director.stage_index == 1:
		director.region_map_index = _debug_map
		director.manifest.enable_campaign()
		director.manifest.record_output(1,&"debug_entry",{"region":String(active_region_id),"map_index":_debug_map,"natural_progression":false})
	if is_instance_valid(shop_modal): shop_modal.close()
	if is_instance_valid(item_toast): item_toast.clear()
	if director.stage_index > 1: GameAudio.cue(self, &"door")
	_stage_pending = true
	controller.router.clear("stage_transition")
	controller.air_focus_ability.stop()
	call_deferred("_load_stage")

func _load_stage() -> void:
	if connected_region and stage is PlainsRegionStage:
		(stage as PlainsRegionStage).capture_state()
		lifetime.invalidate_actor()
	_cancel_enemy_attacks()
	_cancel_stage_shot_latches(true)
	if not lifetime.active:
		return
	if is_instance_valid(policy):
		remove_child(policy)
		policy.queue_free()
	segment = null
	if is_instance_valid(stage):
		remove_child(stage)
		stage.queue_free()
	if connected_region and _region_loaded_map != director.stage_index:
		run_session.select_map_state(director.stage_index)
		_region_chest=-1
		_region_offer=null
		_gold_claimed=false
	var loading_token := lifetime.token()
	if bool(get_meta("plains_world_rebuild_candidate",false)):
		# Explicit isolated new world contract. Keep actual Run/Player/Combat;
		# bypass only the old connected-region map, boss and shop consumers.
		connected_region = false
		var world_generator := load("res://game/world/generation/plains_world_rebuild.gd") as Script
		var world: Dictionary = world_generator.generate(director.seed,int(get_meta("plains_world_rebuild_variant",0)))
		var world_errors: Array = world_generator.validate(world)
		if not world_errors.is_empty():
			push_error("New plains world refused: " + str(world_errors))
			abandon_run()
			return
		var world_stage_script := load("res://game/world/levels/providers/plains_world_rebuild_stage.gd") as Script
		stage = world_stage_script.new() as GeneratedDemoStage
		stage.call("configure_world",world,controller.motor.tuning)
	elif plains_regional_art_candidate_requested:
		var planner := load("res://game/world/generation/plains_region_art_plan.gd") as Script
		var actual_seed := PlainsRegionCampaign.seed_for(director.seed,director.stage_index)
		var candidate: Dictionary = planner.generate(actual_seed,controller.motor.tuning,"intro" if director.stage_index==1 else "advanced","",plains_joint_recoil_candidate_requested,str(get_meta("plains_art_language_candidate","")))
		if not candidate.get("ok",false):
			push_error(str(candidate.get("error","Regional art generation failed")))
			abandon_run()
			return
		stage = PlainsRegionStage.new()
		(stage as PlainsRegionStage).region_state = region_state
		(stage as PlainsRegionStage).map_index = director.stage_index
		(stage as GeneratedDemoStage).configure_generated(candidate,controller.motor.tuning)
	elif plains_environment_candidate_requested:
		var generator: Script = load("res://game/world/generation/plains_place_plan.gd") if plains_places_candidate_requested else load("res://game/world/generation/plains_environment_plan.gd")
		var candidate: Dictionary = generator.generate(director.seed,controller.motor.tuning,plains_environment_variant,plains_environment_mutation)
		if not candidate.ok:
			push_error(str(candidate.error))
			abandon_run()
			return
		stage = generator.create_stage()
		(stage as PlainsRegionStage).region_state = region_state
		(stage as PlainsRegionStage).map_index = director.stage_index
		(stage as GeneratedDemoStage).configure_generated(candidate,controller.motor.tuning)
	elif spatial_golden_requested:
		var golden := PlainsSpatialGolden.generate(director.seed,spatial_golden_mutation,visual_language_open_meadow_requested or not visual_language_sample_path.is_empty())
		if not golden.ok:
			push_error(str(golden.error))
			abandon_run()
			return
		stage = PlainsSpatialGolden.create_stage()
		if not visual_language_sample_path.is_empty():
			stage.set_meta("visual_language_sample_path",visual_language_sample_path)
		(stage as PlainsRegionStage).region_state = region_state
		(stage as PlainsRegionStage).map_index = director.stage_index
		(stage as GeneratedDemoStage).configure_generated(golden,controller.motor.tuning)
	elif generated_plains:
		var request := LevelRequest.new()
		request.root_seed=director.seed
		request.region_id=active_region_id
		request.map_index=director.region_map_index
		request.tuning=controller.motor.tuning
		request.expected_hash=region_state.manifest_hash if region_state!=null else ""
		request.root_bell_mode=_root_bell_run_mode
		request.capabilities={"grapple":controller.traversal.hook_enabled,"weapon_id":String(controller.shoot_ability.weapon.id),"abilities":Array(campaign.abilities),"items":build.item_ids(),"forest_content_version":forest_content_version,"forest_layout_version":_forest_layout_version,"forest_v9_north_return":_forest_v9_north_return}
		var loaded := ForestLevelProvider.load_level(request) if active_region_id==&"thorn_forest" else PlainsLevelProvider.load_level(request)
		if not loaded.accepted():
			_status="GENERATION FAILED / "+loaded.error
			abandon_run()
			return
		if active_region_id==&"thorn_forest":
			forest_content_version=str(loaded.resolved_capabilities.forest_content_version)
			_forest_layout_version=str(loaded.resolved_capabilities.forest_layout_version)
			_forest_v9_north_return=bool(loaded.resolved_capabilities.forest_v9_north_return)
		stage = ThornForestRegionStage.new() if active_region_id == &"thorn_forest" else PlainsRegionStage.new()
		if connected_region:
			(stage as PlainsRegionStage).region_state = region_state
			(stage as PlainsRegionStage).map_index=director.region_map_index
		(stage as GeneratedDemoStage).configure_level(loaded.plan,loaded.legacy_generated,controller.motor.tuning)
		if connected_region:
			var recorded: Dictionary=loaded.legacy_generated.manifest
			print("PLAINS REGION: family=%s areas=%d fallback=%s" % [recorded.family,recorded.areas.size(),recorded.fallback_id])
	else:
		stage = DemoStage.new()
	stage.configure(director.stage_index, director.stage_type_id, director.offers)
	_completion_rule = StageTypeDefinition.registry()[director.stage_type_id].rule(generated_plains or director.stage_type_id == &"combat")
	_completion_target = null
	_enemy_drops = EnemyDropService.new()
	if not _enemy_drops.configure(director.seed, "plains_region" if connected_region else "stage_%s" % director.stage_index):
		push_error("Invalid enemy drop configuration")
		abandon_run()
		return
	if director.stage_index == 1:
		if generated_plains:
			if connected_region:
				if active_region_id == &"thorn_forest": director.manifest.enable_campaign()
				elif (not _explicit_plains_candidate() or plains_regional_art_candidate_requested) and not director.manifest.enable_plains_region((stage as GeneratedDemoStage).generated.stage_generator_version):
					_status = "UNSUPPORTED REGION CONTENT VERSION"
					abandon_run()
					return
			else:
				director.manifest.enable_development_generation((stage as GeneratedDemoStage).generated.stage_generator_version)
		var initial_character := {"id": "prototype_player", "weapon": String(controller.shoot_ability.weapon.id), "max_jumps": controller.motor.tuning.max_jumps, "max_air_shots": controller.motor.tuning.max_air_shots, "input_values": _session_input.duplicate(true)}
		var config_hashes := {"physics": FileAccess.get_sha256("res://config/player_tuning.json"), "input": FileAccess.get_sha256("res://config/input_profile.json"), "health": FileAccess.get_sha256("res://resources/actors/prototype_health.tres")}
		config_hashes.enemy_drops = FileAccess.get_sha256(EnemyDropService.CONFIG_PATH)
		config_hashes.gear_capacity = FileAccess.get_sha256(GearCapacityPolicy.PATH)
		director.manifest.record_output(director.stage_index, &"equipment_contract", {"version": 1, "acquisition": "inventory_only", "initial_capacity": build.equipment.snapshot().capacity, "gear_policy_sha256": config_hashes.gear_capacity})
		if generated_plains:
			var meta_config: Dictionary = JSON.parse_string(FileAccess.get_file_as_string("res://config/meta_upgrades.json"))
			initial_character.current_health = controller.actor_resources.health.current
			initial_character.maximum_health = controller.actor_resources.health.capacity
			initial_character.permanent_upgrades = meta.snapshot().upgrades.duplicate(true)
			initial_character.meta_content_version = meta_config.version
			initial_character.meta_save_schema_version = MetaSaveService.SCHEMA_VERSION
			config_hashes.meta_upgrades = FileAccess.get_sha256("res://config/meta_upgrades.json")
		var content_definitions: Array = [
			{"id": "plains_generated_layout" if generated_plains else "demo_fixed_layout", "version": 1},
			{"id": String(JUMP_ITEM.stable_id), "version": JUMP_ITEM.definition_version},
			{"id": String(SHOT_ITEM.stable_id), "version": SHOT_ITEM.definition_version},
			{"id": String(GOLD_ITEM.stable_id), "version": GOLD_ITEM.definition_version},
			{"id": String(FOREST_GOLD_ITEM.stable_id), "version": FOREST_GOLD_ITEM.definition_version},
			{"id": String(DAMAGE_ITEM.stable_id), "version": DAMAGE_ITEM.definition_version},
			{"id": String(RECOIL_ITEM.stable_id), "version": RECOIL_ITEM.definition_version},
			{"id": String(HEALTH_ITEM.stable_id), "version": HEALTH_ITEM.definition_version},
			{"id": String(COIN_REWARD.stable_id), "version": COIN_REWARD.definition_version},
			{"id": String(HEAL_REWARD.stable_id), "version": HEAL_REWARD.definition_version}]
		if _item_runtime != null:
			config_hashes.items_v5 = FileAccess.get_sha256(ItemCatalogV5.CONFIG_PATH)
			for definition: ItemDefinition in ItemCatalogV5.all_items():
				content_definitions.append({"id":String(definition.stable_id),"version":definition.definition_version,"catalog_version":definition.catalog_version,"fingerprint":definition.fingerprint()})
		director.manifest.record_configuration(content_definitions, config_hashes, initial_character)
	stage.bind_player(controller)
	add_child(stage)
	_sync_region_presentation()
	if stage is PlainsRegionStage and active_region_id == &"plains" and not _explicit_plains_candidate() and (p1_random_plains_requested or "--p1-random-plains" in OS.get_cmdline_user_args()):
		var p1_random := P1RandomPlainsSample.new()
		stage.add_child(p1_random)
		p1_random.install(stage as PlainsRegionStage)
	if _terrain_study_requested and active_region_id == &"plains" and stage is PlainsRegionStage:
		(stage as PlainsRegionStage).terrain_art.enable_comparison()
	if connected_region: (stage as PlainsRegionStage).map_view.open_requested.connect(open_region_map)
	if generated_plains:
		var random_stage := stage as GeneratedDemoStage
		if not random_stage.assembly_ok:
			abandon_run()
			return
		if not is_instance_valid(_run_camera):
			_run_camera = PlainsSpatialGolden.create_camera(random_stage.generated.golden_manifest.camera) if spatial_golden_requested else StageCameraRig.new()
			add_child(_run_camera)
		if connected_region: player.z_index = 5
		_run_camera.region_composition = connected_region and not _explicit_plains_candidate()
		if active_region_id == &"thorn_forest":
			# Keep short jumps inside a stable view; a continuous climb still follows.
			_run_camera.use_stable_forest_view()
		if plains_environment_candidate_requested:
			_run_camera.viewing_zoom = float(random_stage.generated.environment_plan.camera.zoom)
		if plains_regional_art_candidate_requested:
			_run_camera.viewing_zoom = 1.25
		if spatial_golden_requested:
			_run_camera.viewing_zoom = float(random_stage.generated.golden_manifest.camera.zoom)
			_run_camera.dead_zone.y = float(random_stage.generated.golden_manifest.camera.dead_zone_y)
			_run_camera.response_time.y = float(random_stage.generated.golden_manifest.camera.response_y)
		_run_camera.configure(player, random_stage.bounds)
	controller.return_to_segment(stage.spawn)
	if _uses_shared_region_pixel_presentation():
		var presentation:=load("res://game/presentation/world/underworld_plains/underworld_presentation.gd") as Script
		presentation.attach(stage,stage,player)
		if _uses_pixel_plains_presentation():
			(get_node("PixelPlainsParallax") as UnderworldParallax).configure(_run_camera,stage.bounds,(stage as PlainsRegionStage).generated.manifest)
	policy = FrameDamagePolicy.new()
	policy.lifetime = lifetime
	add_child(policy)
	policy.register_target(&"player", controller.actor_resources.health, true)
	policy.register_player_controller(controller)
	policy.player_fatal.connect(_player_fatal)
	policy.environment_return_requested.connect(_environment_return)
	policy.batch_resolved.connect(_damage_resolved.bind(policy, lifetime.stage_epoch, lifetime.epoch))
	segment = SegmentRespawn.new()
	segment.configure(controller, lifetime)
	segment.add_anchor(&"entry", stage.spawn)
	segment.add_anchor(&"midpoint", stage.anchor_position)
	if generated_plains:
		var random_stage := stage as GeneratedDemoStage
		for index: int in random_stage.anchors.size():
			segment.add_anchor(StringName("generated_%s" % index), random_stage.anchors[index])
		segment.danger_bounds = random_stage.assembler.world_dangers()
		random_stage.assembler.setup_damage(controller, policy, lifetime)
		if not random_stage.setup_shot_latches(controller,lifetime):
			_status = "GENERATION FAILED / invalid windchime layout"
			abandon_run()
			return
		if connected_region:
			(random_stage.assembler as PlainsRegionAssembler).attack_shortcut_opened.connect(_record_attack_shortcut_opened.bind(lifetime.stage_epoch,lifetime.epoch))
		director.manifest.record_output(director.stage_index, &"shot_latch_layout", random_stage.generated.manifest.shot_latch_plan)
		var static_records: Array[Dictionary] = []
		if connected_region: static_records.assign(random_stage.assembler.world_static_hazard_records())
		var static_dangers := random_stage.assembler.world_static_dangers()
		for index: int in static_dangers.size():
			var danger: Rect2 = static_dangers[index]
			var emitter := _contact(stage, StringName("generated_spikes_%s" % index), DamageRequest.Kind.ENVIRONMENT, danger.size / 2)
			emitter.position = danger.get_center()
			if connected_region:
				var record: Dictionary = static_records[index]
				emitter.fall_plane = record.role == "fall_plane"
				emitter.set_meta("hazard_role",record.role)
				emitter.set_meta("hazard_module",record.module_id)
				emitter.set_meta("hazard_authored_id",record.authored_id)
	else:
		segment.danger_bounds = [Rect2(780, 530, 80, 110)]
	await get_tree().physics_frame
	if not lifetime.accepts(loading_token) or not is_instance_valid(stage):
		return
	if not segment.activate_anchor(&"entry"):
		_status = "CONTENT ERROR / unsafe generated or fixed entry"
		abandon_run()
		return
	_hazard_contact = null
	if not generated_plains:
		_hazard_contact = _contact(stage, &"saw", DamageRequest.Kind.ENVIRONMENT, Vector2(25, 25))
		_hazard_contact.position = stage.hazard_position
	_enemy_contact = null
	_boss_contact = null
	_boss_started = false
	_boss_was_in_core = false
	_boss_eligible_shots.clear()
	policy.protect_player()
	current_reward = null
	if connected_region and not region_state.boss_state.is_empty() and float(region_state.boss_state.health)<=0:
		director.stage_complete=false
	simple_reward = null
	_pending_exit = &""
	_reward_token = null
	_offered_exit = &""
	_exit_prompt_token = null
	_dismissed_exits.clear()
	_enemy_contacts.clear()

func _physics_process(_delta: float) -> void:
	if get_tree().paused or _stage_pending or not lifetime.active or not is_instance_valid(stage) or not is_instance_valid(controller):
		return
	if director.state != DemoRunDirector.State.IN_STAGE:
		return
	var position_now := player.global_position
	if is_instance_valid(segment) and position_now.distance_to(stage.anchor_position) < 50:
		segment.activate_anchor(&"midpoint")
	if generated_plains:
		var random_stage := stage as GeneratedDemoStage
		if DamageBoundary.should_return(player, random_stage.bounds):
			_submit_damage(&"bounds", DamageRequest.Kind.ENVIRONMENT, 1.0)
		if player.is_on_floor():
			for index: int in random_stage.anchors.size():
				if position_now.distance_to(random_stage.anchors[index]) < 38:
					segment.activate_anchor(StringName("generated_%s" % index))
		for index: int in random_stage.pickups.size():
			var pickup: Dictionary = random_stage.pickups[index]
			if not pickup.claimed and _pickup_within_reach(random_stage,pickup,position_now):
				_queue_action(_commit_pickup.bind(index))
	else:
		if position_now.y > 690 or position_now.y < -350:
			_submit_damage(&"bounds", DamageRequest.Kind.ENVIRONMENT, 1.0)
	if is_instance_valid(_hazard_contact):
		_hazard_contact.position = stage.hazard_position
	if is_instance_valid(_enemy_contact):
		_enemy_contact.enabled = not stage.enemy.get_node("Actor").health.terminal
	for contact: DemoContactEmitter in _enemy_contacts:
		if is_instance_valid(contact):
			contact.enabled = not (contact.get_parent().get_node("Actor") as EnemyActor).health.terminal
	if is_instance_valid(_boss_contact):
		if generated_plains:
			var in_core := _in_boss_core()
			if _boss_was_in_core and not in_core:
				_boss_eligible_shots.clear()
			_boss_was_in_core = in_core
			if not _boss_started and in_core and not controller.actor_resources.health.terminal:
				_start_generated_boss()
			var boss_state := stage.boss.get_node("Encounter") as BossEncounter
			if connected_region and _boss_started and in_core and (stage as PlainsRegionStage).boss_seal.arm():segment.activate_anchor(&"boss_enter")
			_boss_contact.enabled = _boss_started and in_core and bool(boss_state.call("body_contact_enabled"))
		else:
			_boss_contact.enabled = not stage.boss.get_node("Encounter").health.terminal

func _submit_damage(source: StringName, kind: DamageRequest.Kind, amount: float, event: StringName = &"", hit_direction: Vector2 = Vector2.ZERO) -> void:
	var request := DamageRequest.new()
	request.token = lifetime.token()
	request.event_id = _next_id(str(source)) if event.is_empty() else event
	request.source_id = source
	request.target_id = &"player"
	request.kind = kind
	request.fall = source in [&"bounds", &"fall", &"fall_plane"]
	request.amount = amount
	request.hit_direction = hit_direction
	request.health_epoch = controller.actor_resources.health.epoch
	request.actor_epoch = lifetime.actor_epoch
	policy.submit(request)

func _boss_projectile_created(projectile: Node) -> void:
	projectile.hit.connect(func(body: Node, event_id: StringName, amount: float) -> void:
		if body == player and lifetime.active and is_instance_valid(policy) and (not generated_plains or (_boss_started and _in_boss_core())):
			_submit_damage(&"boss_projectile", DamageRequest.Kind.MONSTER, amount, event_id, projectile.direction)
	)

func _damage_resolved(_results: Array[DamageResult], batch_policy: FrameDamagePolicy = null, batch_stage_epoch: int = -1, batch_run_epoch: int = -1) -> void:
	if not lifetime.active:
		_queued_actions.clear()
		return
	# Director advances synchronously; the old stage can emit an empty batch
	# before deferred loading, or while the next stage waits for its first frame.
	if _stage_pending or director.state != DemoRunDirector.State.IN_STAGE:
		return
	if batch_policy != null and (batch_policy != policy or batch_stage_epoch != lifetime.stage_epoch or batch_run_epoch != lifetime.epoch):
		return
	var was_complete := director.stage_complete
	var claimed := (current_reward != null and rewards.get_offer(current_reward.offer_id).claimed) or (simple_reward != null and simple_reward.claimed)
	var completed_now := _completion_rule.evaluate(player.global_position, _completion_target, claimed)
	if generated_plains:
		var random_stage := stage as GeneratedDemoStage
		# Ordinary rooms allow leaving living enemies behind; Boss remains terminal-only.
		match _completion_rule.goal:
			StageCompletionRule.Goal.REACH_FINISH:
				completed_now = random_stage.reached_finish(player.global_position)
			StageCompletionRule.Goal.CLAIM_AND_REACH:
				completed_now = random_stage.reached_finish(player.global_position)
			StageCompletionRule.Goal.CLAIM:
				completed_now = random_stage.reached_finish(player.global_position)
	if completed_now:
		_complete_room()
	if not was_complete and director.stage_complete:
		if stage.boss != null:
			if not connected_region or director.region_map_index==2:
				current_reward = rewards.create_gold_offer(_stage_id("gold"), _v5_boss_gold() if _item_runtime != null else FOREST_GOLD_ITEM if active_region_id == &"thorn_forest" else GOLD_ITEM, _stage_id("boss_defeat"))
			stage.reward_position = stage.boss.global_position
			var defeated_encounter := stage.boss.get_node("Encounter")
			if defeated_encounter.has_method("reward_stand_position"): stage.reward_position = defeated_encounter.call("reward_stand_position")
			var bellstrider_reward := defeated_encounter is BellstriderEncounter and connected_region
			stage.reward_available = not bellstrider_reward
			if connected_region:
				var region:=stage as PlainsRegionStage
				var animate:bool=not region.restored_boss.has("health") or float(region.restored_boss.health)>0
				region.reward_ready_at=region.clock+((defeated_encounter.definition as BellstriderDefinition).death_seconds if bellstrider_reward and animate else .9 if animate else 0)
				if defeated_encounter is WindkeeperPressureEncounter:
					region.reward_ready_at = region.clock + (defeated_encounter.definition as WindkeeperPressureDefinition).death_seconds if animate else region.clock
				region.boss_seal.release()
				if active_region_id == &"plains" and not defeated_encounter is WindkeeperPressureEncounter: (region.visual_layer as PlainsStageVisual).play_boss_defeat(stage.boss.global_position,director.region_map_index==1,animate)

			if current_reward!=null: _record_reward()
			if generated_plains and not bellstrider_reward:
				(stage as GeneratedDemoStage).show_boss_reward_portal()
			_status = "Boss defeated. Approach the GOLD gate and confirm to claim." if generated_plains else "Boss defeated. Claim the guaranteed GOLD item to finish."
			if connected_region and director.region_map_index==1: _status="MINI BOSS CLEAR / approach MAP 2 gate / build and coins carry over"
	# Fixed demo reward remains a defeat fixture, independent of the newly-open
	# door policy. Opening an ordinary room must not grant entry-time money.
	if not generated_plains and stage.enemy != null and (stage.enemy.get_node("Actor") as EnemyActor).health.terminal:
		wallet.grant(10, _stage_id("combat_coins"))
	_settle_bellstrider_rewards()
	_settle_enemy_drops()
	_flush_actions()
	# Contact is observed only after this frame's damage batch and queued intents.
	if generated_plains and _can_interact() and director.stage_complete and (not connected_region or stage.clock>=stage.reward_ready_at) and not _windkeeper_pressure_rewards_pending():
		var exit_index := stage.nearby_exit(player.global_position)
		if exit_index >= 0:
			_commit_exit(stage.exits[exit_index].exit_id)
		elif current_reward != null and current_reward.gold and player.global_position.distance_to(stage.reward_position) < 100:
			_offer_generated_exit(&"boss_home")
		elif connected_region and director.region_map_index==1 and stage.reward_available and player.global_position.distance_to(stage.reward_position)<100 and not _bellstrider_coins_pending():
			_offer_generated_exit(&"boss_home")
		_rearm_exit_prompts()

func _settle_enemy_drops() -> void:
	if not _can_interact() or not stage is GeneratedDemoStage or _enemy_drops == null:
		return
	var random_stage := stage as GeneratedDemoStage
	for index: int in random_stage.enemies.size():
		var enemy_motor: EnemyMotor = random_stage.enemies[index]
		var actor := enemy_motor.get_node("Actor") as EnemyActor
		if not actor.health.terminal:
			continue
