func _input(event: InputEvent) -> void:
	# Presentation entry only; reuse the existing pause/cancellation boundary.
	if event is InputEventJoypadButton and event.pressed and event.button_index == JOY_BUTTON_START and menu.visible_panel.is_empty():
		toggle_pause()
		get_viewport().set_input_as_handled()
		return
	if _forest_reader_open():
		if event is InputEventKey and event.pressed and not event.echo and event.physical_keycode == KEY_ESCAPE:
			(stage as ThornForestRegionStage).discoveries.close()
			get_viewport().set_input_as_handled()
		# The reader owns its buttons, scrolling and navigation until it closes.
		return
	if event is InputEventKey and event.pressed and not event.echo:
		if is_instance_valid(shop_modal) and shop_modal.opened:
			if event.physical_keycode==KEY_ESCAPE: _close_region_shop()
			get_viewport().set_input_as_handled()
			return
		if is_instance_valid(map_modal) and map_modal.opened:
			if event.physical_keycode in [KEY_M,KEY_ESCAPE]: close_region_map()
			get_viewport().set_input_as_handled()
			return
		if event.physical_keycode==KEY_M and connected_region:
			open_region_map()
			get_viewport().set_input_as_handled()
			return
	if event is InputEventKey and event.pressed and not event.echo and event.physical_keycode == KEY_F3:
		debug_hud = not debug_hud
	if director.state == DemoRunDirector.State.IN_STAGE and event is InputEventKey and event.pressed and not event.echo and event.physical_keycode == KEY_ESCAPE and menu.visible_panel.is_empty():
		toggle_pause()
		get_viewport().set_input_as_handled()

func _grant_home_carry() -> bool:
	if not lifetime.active or not connected_region or build == null or _run_receipt_prefix == _home_carry_granted_run: return false
	# Latch the departure, including a deliberately empty selection. Reloads and
	# region changes cannot become a second departure with a different item.
	_home_carry_granted_run = _run_receipt_prefix
	var id := StringName(meta.snapshot().get("selected_home_item", ""))
	if id.is_empty(): return true
	if not bool(meta.home_item_quote(id).get("can_select", false)): return false
	var item := HomeItemCatalog.item(id)
	var source := StringName("home_carry/%s" % _run_receipt_prefix)
	if item == null or not build.add_item(source, item, &"home_carry"): return false
	director.manifest.record_output(director.stage_index, &"home_item_carry", {"definition_id":str(id), "instance_id":str(build.inventory.instance_for_source(source).instance_id), "level":1, "equipped":false})
	# A policy may permit unlocking an unseen item. Reveal it only after this
	# actual departure grant succeeds, never merely by buying or browsing it.
	_queue_item_discovery(id, "%s/discovery/%s" % [_run_receipt_prefix, source])
	return true

func _record_item_discovery(receipt: EconomyReceipt, run_id: String, from_shop: bool) -> void:
	if receipt == null or receipt.status != EconomyReceipt.Status.COMMITTED or run_id != _run_receipt_prefix or not lifetime.active or build == null: return
	var owned := build.inventory.get_instance(receipt.instance_id)
	if owned == null or owned.definition_id != receipt.item_id or owned.item.catalog_version != 5: return
	if from_shop:
		# Repairs/gear purchases also emit purchased; only a committed acquisition
		# has this inventory source receipt (including same-instance growth).
		var acquisition := build.inventory.source_receipt(StringName("shop:%s" % receipt.event_id))
		if acquisition.get("instance_id", &"") != receipt.instance_id: return
	var key := "%s/discovery/%s" % [run_id, receipt.event_id]
	_queue_item_discovery(receipt.item_id, key)

func _queue_item_discovery(item_id: StringName, key: String) -> void:
	_pending_item_discoveries[key] = {"id":item_id,"profile_context":meta.profile_context_id()}
	_flush_item_discoveries()

func _flush_item_discoveries() -> void:
	for key: String in _pending_item_discoveries.keys():
		var pending: Dictionary = _pending_item_discoveries[key]
		if pending.profile_context != meta.profile_context_id():
			_pending_item_discoveries.erase(key)
			continue
		var result := meta.discover_item(pending.id, StringName(key))
		if result.accepted: _pending_item_discoveries.erase(key)

func _layout_region_hud() -> void:
	# Health, resonance and ammunition keep their viewport-safe status anchor.
	# Navigation and temporary notices still avoid actual gameplay targets.
	# Only two stable edge layouts. Read visible actors and projectiles, never
	# move gameplay bodies or read the test driver's desired route.
	var blockers: Array[Rect2] = []
	var transform := player.get_canvas_transform()
	blockers.append(transform * Rect2(player.global_position-Vector2(22,38),Vector2(44,65)))
	if stage is PlainsRegionStage:
		for enemy: EnemyMotor in stage.enemies:
			var actor := enemy.get_node("Actor") as EnemyActor
			if actor.health.terminal or enemy.global_position.distance_to(player.global_position)>450:continue
			blockers.append(transform * Rect2(enemy.global_position-actor.definition.collision_size*.5,actor.definition.collision_size).grow(12))
			if actor.attack_behavior!=null:
				var attack:=actor.attack_behavior
				if attack.state in [&"telegraph",&"attack"]:blockers.append(transform*Rect2(attack.attack_origin-Vector2(20,20),Vector2(40,40)))
				for projectile:EnemyAttackProjectile in attack._projectiles:
					if is_instance_valid(projectile) and not projectile.spent:blockers.append(transform*Rect2(projectile.global_position-Vector2.ONE*12,Vector2.ONE*24))
	var critical_count := blockers.size()
	var required_regions: Array[Rect2]=[]
	var viewport:=get_viewport_rect()
	if stage is PlainsRegionStage:
		for module: PlatformingModule in stage.assembler.modules:
			for anchor: Vector2 in module.definition.anchors:
				var point := module.global_position+anchor
				var projected:=transform*Rect2(point-Vector2(26,48),Vector2(52,65))
				if viewport.intersects(projected):blockers.append(projected)
			if module.definition.module_id==&"plains_windchime_well":
				var bank: Rect2=module.definition.platforms[1]
				var receiver:=transform*Rect2(module.global_position+bank.position-Vector2(0,36),Vector2(bank.size.x,36))
				if viewport.intersects(receiver):required_regions.append(receiver.intersection(viewport))
		for latch: ShotLatch in (stage as PlainsRegionStage).shot_latches:
			var point := latch.global_position+latch.bell_position
			var projected:=transform*Rect2(point-Vector2(20,30),Vector2(40,60))
			if viewport.intersects(projected):
				blockers.append(projected)
				if not latch.is_open:required_regions.append(projected.intersection(viewport))
	var touch_regions:=_region_touch_regions()
	touch_regions.append_array(required_regions)
	var hud_candidates: Array = [Vector2(12,8),Vector2(12,382),Vector2(12,220)] if overlay.enabled else [Vector2(12,8),Vector2(12,590)]
	var best:=Vector2(12,8)
	var score:=INF
	for candidate:Vector2 in hud_candidates:
		# Compact resource labels extend beyond the old fixed bottom slot.
		# Score the real in-viewport panel position, including its full height.
		candidate=candidate.clamp(viewport.position+Vector2(8,8),viewport.end-_hud_frame.size-Vector2(8,8))
		var bounds:=Rect2(candidate,_hud_frame.size).grow(5)
		if touch_regions.any(func(region: Rect2):return region.intersects(bounds)):continue
		var overlap:=0.0
		for index: int in blockers.size():
			var cut:=bounds.intersection(blockers[index])
			overlap+=cut.get_area()*(1000000.0 if index==0 else 1000.0 if index<critical_count else 1.0)
		if overlap<score:score=overlap;best=candidate
	_hud_frame.position=best
	var shift:=best-Vector2(12,8)
	_title.position=Vector2(22,8 if _explicit_plains_candidate() else 14)+shift
	_title.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size",14 if _explicit_plains_candidate() else 16)
	_hud.position=Vector2(22,30 if plains_environment_candidate_requested else 29)+shift
	_resources_hud.position=shift+Vector2(0,8 if plains_environment_candidate_requested else 0)
	if stage is PlainsRegionStage:
		var cards: Array[Control] = _demo_hud.region_layout_controls()
		var card_reservations: Array[Rect2] = []
		for card: Control in cards:
			if card == _demo_hud._rows:
				for widget: Control in _demo_hud.status_draw_controls():
					card_reservations.append(widget.get_global_rect())
			else:
				card_reservations.append(card.get_global_rect())
		var navigation_reserved: Array[Rect2] = touch_regions.duplicate()
		navigation_reserved.append_array(card_reservations)
		var map := (stage as PlainsRegionStage).map_view
		if is_instance_valid(map):
			map.position = _clear_ui_edge(_region_ui_positions.get("map",map.position),map.size*map.scale,[map.position]+([Vector2(1098,78),Vector2(1098,142),Vector2(952,78)] if overlay.enabled else [Vector2(1098,14),Vector2(1098,674)]),blockers,critical_count,navigation_reserved)
			_region_ui_positions["map"]=map.position
			touch_regions.append(map.get_global_rect())
			navigation_reserved.append(map.get_global_rect())
		if _pause_button.is_visible_in_tree():
			_pause_button.position = _clear_ui_edge(_region_ui_positions.get("pause",_pause_button.position),_pause_button.size*_pause_button.scale,[_pause_button.position,Vector2(1150,75),Vector2(1150,620)],blockers,critical_count,navigation_reserved)
			_region_ui_positions["pause"]=_pause_button.position
			touch_regions.append(_pause_button.get_global_rect())
		for index: int in cards.size():
			var card: Control=cards[index]
			if card == _demo_hud._rows:
				continue
			var extent:=card.size*card.scale
			var reserved: Array[Rect2]=touch_regions.duplicate()
			for other: Control in cards:

func _clear_ui_edge(current: Vector2, extent: Vector2, candidates: Array, blockers: Array[Rect2], critical_count: int=1, reserved: Array[Rect2]=[]) -> Vector2:
	var viewport:=get_viewport_rect()
	var best := current.clamp(viewport.position+Vector2(8,8),(viewport.end-extent-Vector2(8,8)).max(viewport.position+Vector2(8,8)))
	var cost := INF
	var choices: Array = [current]
	choices.append_array(candidates)
	for at: Vector2 in choices:
		at=at.clamp(viewport.position+Vector2(8,8),(viewport.end-extent-Vector2(8,8)).max(viewport.position+Vector2(8,8)))
		if reserved.any(func(region: Rect2):return region.intersects(Rect2(at,extent).grow(8))):continue
		var overlap := 0.0
		for index: int in blockers.size(): overlap += Rect2(at,extent).grow(8).intersection(blockers[index]).get_area()*(1000000.0 if index==0 else 1000.0 if index<critical_count else 1.0)
		if overlap < cost: cost = overlap; best = at
	return best

func _pickup_within_reach(random_stage: GeneratedDemoStage, pickup: Dictionary, player_world: Vector2) -> bool:
	var pickup_world := random_stage.to_global(pickup.position)
	if player_world.distance_to(pickup_world) < 46: return true
	if _item_runtime == null: return false
	# Magnet line-of-sight queries consume world coordinates. Do not mutate the
	# authoritative Stage-local pickup while adapting that existing consumer.
	var world_pickup := pickup.duplicate()
	world_pickup.position = pickup_world
	return _item_runtime.can_magnet_pickup(world_pickup,player_world,random_stage.clock)

func _commit_pickup(index: int) -> bool:
	if not _can_interact() or not stage is GeneratedDemoStage:
		return false
	var random_stage := stage as GeneratedDemoStage
	if index < 0 or index >= random_stage.pickups.size():
		return false
	var pickup: Dictionary = random_stage.pickups[index]
	if pickup.claimed or random_stage.clock<float(pickup.get("ready_at",0)) or not _pickup_within_reach(random_stage,pickup,player.global_position):
		return false
	var receipt_id := StringName("%s/stage_%s/%s" % [_run_receipt_prefix, director.stage_index, pickup.id])
	var healed_amount := 0.0
	if pickup.kind == "coin":
		if not wallet.grant(pickup.amount, receipt_id):
			return false
		random_stage.coins_collected += pickup.amount
	elif pickup.kind == "heart":
		if controller.actor_resources.health.current >= controller.actor_resources.health.capacity:
			return false
		var healed := SupplyHealEffect.apply(controller.actor_resources.health, float(pickup.amount), receipt_id)
		if not healed.accepted():
			return false
		healed_amount=healed.amount_applied
		if pickup.id == "supply_heart":
			random_stage.mark_supply_used()
	elif pickup.kind == "note":
		var receipt := meta.grant_notes(pickup.amount, receipt_id)
		if not receipt.accepted:
			_status = "NOTES SAVE FAILED / " + str(receipt.reason)
			return false
	else:
		return false
	pickup.claimed = true
	pickup.claimed_position=pickup.position
	pickup.claimed_at=random_stage.clock
	if connected_region: region_state.claimed[pickup.id] = true
	GameAudio.cue(self, &"coin" if pickup.kind == "coin" else &"heal" if pickup.kind == "heart" else &"note")
	var feedback := player.get_node_or_null("PlayerFeedback") as PlayerFeedback
	if feedback != null:
		if pickup.kind=="heart":feedback.healing_received(healed_amount)
		else:feedback.reward_received(random_stage.to_global(pickup.position), pickup.kind == "note")
	random_stage._persist_pickup_motion()
	director.manifest.record_output(director.stage_index, StringName("pickup_claim_" + str(pickup.id)), {"id": pickup.id, "kind": pickup.kind, "amount": pickup.amount,"healed_amount":healed_amount})
	return true

func _in_boss_core() -> bool:
	if not generated_plains or not is_instance_valid(stage) or not stage is GeneratedDemoStage or not is_instance_valid(player):return false
	var arena:Rect2=(stage as GeneratedDemoStage).boss_arena
	if connected_region and stage is PlainsRegionStage:
		var seal:BossArenaSeal=(stage as PlainsRegionStage).boss_seal
		# The real sealed walls define containment. A legal jump/recoil can pass
		# above the old trigger rectangle without leaving the combat arena.
		if is_instance_valid(seal) and seal.closed:
			return seal.containment.has_point(player.global_position)
	return arena.has_point(player.global_position)

func _bellstrider_hook_admitted(context: Dictionary, receiver: Damageable) -> bool:
	if not _live_bellstrider() or context.get("damage_type", &"") != &"grapple": return false
	var traversal: TraversalAbility = controller.traversal
	if traversal.state != &"hook_pull" or not is_instance_valid(traversal.hook_target): return false
	var spatial := traversal.hook_target.get_node_or_null("Damageable") as Damageable
	return spatial != null and spatial != receiver and spatial.can_receive_effects() and spatial.damage_policy_owner() == receiver and int(context.get("session_id",-1)) == controller.session_id and int(context.get("attack_id",-1)) == traversal._serial and int(context.get("source_actor_id",0)) == player.get_instance_id() and int(context.get("target_actor_id",-1)) == receiver.actor_id and int(context.get("target_epoch",-1)) == receiver.damage_epoch

	if not encounter.has_method("valid_duel_snapshot") or not encounter.call("valid_duel_snapshot",data): return false
	var saved_health: Variant = data.get("health")
	if typeof(saved_health) not in [TYPE_INT,TYPE_FLOAT] or not is_finite(float(saved_health)) or float(saved_health) < 0 or float(saved_health) > encounter.health.capacity: return false
	var saved_position: Variant = data.get("position")
	if not saved_position is Array or saved_position.size() != 2: return false
	for coordinate: Variant in saved_position:
		if typeof(coordinate) not in [TYPE_INT,TYPE_FLOAT] or not is_finite(float(coordinate)): return false
	var body_position: Variant = data.get("body_position")
	if not body_position is Array or body_position.size() != 2: return false
	for index: int in 2:
		if typeof(body_position[index]) not in [TYPE_INT,TYPE_FLOAT] or not is_finite(float(body_position[index])) or not is_equal_approx(float(body_position[index]),float(saved_position[index])): return false
	var restored := encounter.definition.health_definition.duplicate(true) as HealthDefinition
	restored.initial_current = float(saved_health)
	encounter.health.configure(restored)
	encounter.damageable.bind_health(encounter.health)
	encounter.call("restore_combat_state",data)
	return encounter.get("last_restore_accepted") == true and encounter.motor.position.is_equal_approx(Vector2(saved_position[0],saved_position[1]))

func _start_generated_boss() -> void:
	var encounter := stage.boss.get_node("Encounter") as BossEncounter
	var receiver := stage.boss.get_node("Damageable") as Damageable
	if not policy.bind_damageable(&"boss", receiver, encounter.health):
		return
	var sink := receiver.damage_sink
	receiver.damage_sink = func(context: Dictionary) -> bool:
		var key := "%s:%s" % [context.get("session_id", -1), context.get("shot_id", -1)]
		var authorized_item := _item_runtime != null and bool(context.get("item_effect_damage", false)) and _item_runtime.authorizes_effect(context, receiver)
		var admitted_packet: bool = _boss_eligible_shots.get(key, -1) == lifetime.actor_epoch
		if encounter is BellstriderEncounter:
			admitted_packet = admitted_packet and int(context.get("source_actor_id",0)) == player.get_instance_id() and context.get("source_faction",&"") == &"player" and int(context.get("session_id",-1)) == controller.session_id
		return _boss_started and _in_boss_core() and lifetime.active and (admitted_packet or authorized_item or _bellstrider_hook_admitted(context, receiver)) and sink.call(context) == true
	if encounter is WindkeeperEncounter: encounter.intro_seen = _boss_intros_seen.has(encounter.definition.stable_id)
	_boss_started = encounter.activate()
	if connected_region and _boss_started:
		var data: Dictionary=(stage as PlainsRegionStage).restored_boss
		if data.get("active",false):
			if encounter.has_method("bind_duel"):
				if not _restore_forest_duel(encounter,data):
					push_error("Recorded active forest duel rejected")
					abandon_run()
					return
			elif encounter.has_method("restore_combat_state"): encounter.call("restore_combat_state",data)
			if encounter is WindkeeperPressureEncounter: _restore_windkeeper_pressure_bridge(encounter)
		(stage as PlainsRegionStage).restored_boss.clear()
	EnemyPresentationBinding.synchronize(encounter)
	if _boss_started and encounter is WindkeeperEncounter: _boss_intros_seen[encounter.definition.stable_id]=true
	if _boss_started:
		_status = ("BOSS ACTIVE / Branch seals close after full entry." if active_region_id == &"thorn_forest" else "BOSS ACTIVE / Wind gates close after full entry.") if connected_region else "BOSS ACTIVE / Core entered. Retreat into the entrance is safe; Boss health persists."

func _region_interact() -> void:
	var rs := stage as PlainsRegionStage
	var index := rs.nearby_chest(player.global_position)
	if index >= 0:
		var chest: Dictionary = rs.chests[index]
		var items: Array[ItemDefinition] = []
		if _item_runtime != null:
			items = _v5_cache_items(chest)
		else:
			for id: String in chest.items:
				var item := load("res://resources/items/%s.tres" % id) as ItemDefinition
				if build.can_add(item): items.append(item)
		# Keep every eligible item; resources are real, tier-valued alternatives.
		var selected: Array[ItemDefinition]=[]
		if str(chest.reward_mode)!="resources" and not items.is_empty(): selected.append(items[0])
		var item_offer: RewardOffer=null
		if not selected.is_empty(): item_offer=rewards.create_cache_offer(StringName(chest.id),selected,StringName(chest.id+"/source"))
		if not selected.is_empty() and item_offer==null: return
		_region_offer=item_offer.copy() if item_offer!=null else RewardOffer.new()
		_region_offer.offer_id=StringName(chest.id)
		_region_offer.candidates.clear()
		_region_offer.candidates.assign(selected)
		for resource: Dictionary in chest.resources:
			if _region_offer.candidates.size()>=2: break
			if resource.kind=="heart" and controller.actor_resources.health.current>=controller.actor_resources.health.capacity: continue
			var tier: ItemDefinition.Rarity=ItemDefinition.Rarity.BLUE if chest.tier=="medium" else ItemDefinition.Rarity.PURPLE if chest.tier=="high" else ItemDefinition.Rarity.GOLD
			_region_offer.candidates.append(ResourceRewardChoice.make(StringName(chest.id+"/resource/"+resource.kind),str(resource.kind),int(resource.amount),tier))
		if _region_offer.candidates.size()<2 and items.size()>1: _region_offer.candidates.append(items[1])
		# A full-health resource-only cache still offers a valuable note alternative.
		if _region_offer.candidates.size()<2:
			_region_offer.candidates.append(ResourceRewardChoice.make(StringName(chest.id+"/resource/note"),"note",1 if chest.tier=="medium" else 2 if chest.tier=="high" else 4,ItemDefinition.Rarity.BLUE if chest.tier=="medium" else ItemDefinition.Rarity.PURPLE if chest.tier=="high" else ItemDefinition.Rarity.GOLD))
		_region_pending_claim=false
		_region_chest = index
		_region_offer_token = lifetime.token()
		controller.router.clear("region_cache")
		controller.air_focus_ability.stop()
		get_tree().paused = true
		reward_modal.show_offer(_region_offer,"Continue exploring / " + str(chest.tier))
		return
	if _open_forest_discovery(): return
	if player.global_position.distance_to(rs.merchant_position) < 90:
		_open_region_shop()

func _claim_region_chest(option_id: StringName) -> bool:
	if not lifetime.accepts(_region_offer_token) or controller.actor_resources.health.terminal or not reward_modal.opened: return false
	var rs := stage as PlainsRegionStage
	var chest: Dictionary = rs.chests[_region_chest]
	if chest.claimed: return false
	var selected: ItemDefinition=null
	for item: ItemDefinition in _region_offer.candidates:
		if item.stable_id==option_id: selected=item
	if selected==null: return false
	var resource:=selected as ResourceRewardChoice
	var audio_committed := false
	if resource!=null:
		var id:=StringName(_run_receipt_prefix+"/"+chest.id+"/resource")
		if resource.resource_kind=="coin":
			var before_balance := wallet.balance
			if not wallet.grant(resource.amount,id): return false
			audio_committed = wallet.balance != before_balance
		elif resource.resource_kind=="heart":
			if controller.actor_resources.health.current>=controller.actor_resources.health.capacity: return false
			var healed := SupplyHealEffect.apply(controller.actor_resources.health,float(resource.amount),id)
			if not healed.accepted(): return false
			audio_committed = healed.status == ActorResourceResult.Status.APPLIED and healed.amount_applied > 0.0
		else:
			var saved:=meta.grant_notes(resource.amount,id)
			if not saved.accepted:
				_status="NOTES SAVE FAILED / Nothing granted. Retry this choice."
				return false
			audio_committed = not bool(saved.get("replayed", false))
	else:
		var request:=RewardClaimRequest.new()
		request.token=_region_offer_token;request.offer_id=_region_offer.offer_id;request.option_id=option_id;request.claim_id=StringName(chest.id+"/claim")
		var receipt := rewards.claim(request)
		if not receipt.accepted(): return false
		audio_committed = receipt.status == EconomyReceipt.Status.COMMITTED
		wallet.grant(int(chest.coins),StringName(chest.id+"/coins"))
	item_toast.show_item(selected)
	if connected_region: _layout_region_hud()
	_status="CACHE CLAIMED / "+selected.display_name.split(" / ")[-1]
	chest.claimed = true
	region_state.claimed[chest.id] = true
	if rs is ThornForestRegionStage:
		(rs.assembler as ThornForestRegionAssembler).resolve_reward_shortcuts()
	director.manifest.record_output(director.stage_index,StringName("cache/"+chest.id),{"choice": String(option_id),"resource":resource.resource_kind if resource!=null else "item","amount":resource.amount if resource!=null else int(chest.coins)})
	_region_chest = -1
	_region_offer = null
	reward_modal.close()
	controller.router.clear("region_cache_complete")
	get_tree().paused = false
	_resume_exit_input()
	if audio_committed:
		GameAudio.cue_committed_reward(self, &"chest_open", &"confirm")
		if resource == null:
			GameAudio.cue_committed_reward(self, &"item_get", &"note")
		else:
			GameAudio.cue(self, &"coin" if resource.resource_kind == "coin" else &"heal" if resource.resource_kind == "heart" else &"note")
	return true

	var quote := shop.quote(_region_shop_id())

func _sync_region_presentation(home := false) -> void:
	# Select presentation from the assembled consumer, including a reused player
	# crossing from Plains to Forest. This owns no movement or ability state.
	var plains := not home and _uses_pixel_plains_presentation()
	var pixel := not home and _uses_shared_region_pixel_presentation()
	var parallax := get_node("PixelPlainsParallax") as PixelPlainsParallax
	# Home owns its own configured instance; avoid drawing six duplicate planes.
	parallax.visible = plains
	(get_node("PlainsBackground") as PlainsBackground).visible = not pixel and not home
	if plains: parallax.origin = stage.spawn
	var avatar := get_meta("avatar_presentation",null) as Node
	if is_instance_valid(avatar):
		var selector_layer := avatar.get_node_or_null("AvatarSelectorLayer") as CanvasLayer
		if selector_layer != null: selector_layer.visible = false
	if home or not is_instance_valid(player): return
	var visual := player.get_node_or_null("PixelPlainsActor") as PixelPlainsActor
	if pixel and visual == null:
		visual = PlayerPresentationRuntime.make_body(player, controller, "PixelPlainsActor", avatar_selection_id)
		player.add_child(visual)
	elif not pixel and visual != null:
		PlayerPresentationRuntime._remove(player, "MotionFeel")
		PlayerPresentationRuntime._remove(player, "WeaponFeel")
		player.remove_child(visual)
		visual.queue_free()
	var courier := player.get_node("CourierVisual") as CanvasItem
	var feedback := player.get_node("PlayerFeedback") as CanvasItem
	player.get_node("PlayerVisualAdapter").process_mode = Node.PROCESS_MODE_DISABLED if pixel else Node.PROCESS_MODE_INHERIT
	courier.visible = not pixel
	feedback.visible = not pixel
	for child: Node in player.get_children():
		if child.has_meta("avatar_presentation_owned") and child is CanvasItem:
			(child as CanvasItem).visible = not pixel
			if not pixel: courier.hide()
	# The source-art selector is session-only; rebind after pixel disposal so a
	# deliberate alternate avatar can be restored on non-pixel consumers.
	if is_instance_valid(avatar): avatar.call("bind_player",player)

func _bind_forest_discoveries() -> bool:
	if not stage is ThornForestRegionStage: return true
	var forest := stage as ThornForestRegionStage
	if ForestBiblePresentation.enabled(forest.generated.manifest):
		ForestBibleActors.install(forest, forest.generated.manifest, forest.enemies, forest.enemy_manifest)
		forest.texture_filter = CanvasItem.TEXTURE_FILTER_NEAREST
		forest.assembler.texture_filter = CanvasItem.TEXTURE_FILTER_NEAREST
		forest.ambience = ForestBibleAmbience.new()
		forest.add_child(forest.ambience)
		forest.ambience.configure(forest.generated.manifest, player, _reduced_effects)
		forest.near_scenery = ForestBibleNearScenery.new()
		forest.add_child(forest.near_scenery)
		forest.move_child(forest.near_scenery, forest.assembler.get_index()+1)
		if not forest.near_scenery.configure(forest.generated.manifest, player, _reduced_effects):
			return false
	var rows: Array = forest.generated.manifest.get("forest_discoveries", [])
	if rows.is_empty(): return true
	var reader := ForestBibleDiscoveries.new()
	forest.add_child(reader)
	if not reader.configure(rows, region_state, lifetime, controller.actor_resources.health, wallet, rewards):
		push_error("Recorded forest discoveries rejected")
		return false
	forest.discoveries = reader
	reader.opened.connect(func() -> void:
		if is_instance_valid(stage) and stage == forest and lifetime.active: _pause_for_menu())
	reader.closed.connect(func() -> void:
		if not is_instance_valid(stage) or stage != forest or not lifetime.active or _stage_pending: return
		if is_instance_valid(controller): controller.router.clear("forest_reader_close")
		_resume_exit_input()
		if director.state == DemoRunDirector.State.IN_STAGE: get_tree().paused = false)
	reader.confirm_requested.connect(func() -> void:
		if not is_instance_valid(stage) or stage != forest or not lifetime.active: return
		controller.router.clear("forest_reader_confirm")
		get_tree().paused = false
		if not _queue_action(_commit_forest_discovery.bind(reader)) and reader.is_open(): _pause_for_menu())
	reader.acquired.connect(func(receipt: Dictionary) -> void:
		if not is_instance_valid(stage) or stage != forest or not lifetime.active: return
		director.manifest.record_output(director.stage_index, StringName("forest_discovery/" + str(receipt.id)), receipt)
		(forest.assembler as ThornForestRegionAssembler).resolve_reward_shortcuts()
		if str(receipt.kind) != "item":
			GameAudio.cue(self, &"coin" if str(receipt.kind) == "coin" else &"heal" if str(receipt.kind) == "heart" else &"confirm")
		_shown_actions = ""
		forest.queue_redraw())
	return true

func _commit_forest_discovery(reader: ForestBibleDiscoveries) -> bool:
	if not is_instance_valid(reader) or not stage is ThornForestRegionStage or (stage as ThornForestRegionStage).discoveries != reader: return false
	return reader.commit_pending(player.global_position)

func _restore_windkeeper_pressure_bridge(encounter: WindkeeperPressureEncounter) -> void:
	# A saved transition may still be landing on its first real shelf. Restore
	# the actual break flag, independently of the requested health phase.
	if not encounter.bridge_break_ready(): return
	for child: Node in encounter.get_children():
		if child is WindkeeperArena: (child as WindkeeperArena)._phase_changed(3)


func _bind_windkeeper_pressure_rewards(encounter: WindkeeperPressureEncounter) -> void:
	var voice := stage.boss.get_node_or_null("Audio") as WindkeeperPressureAudio
	if voice != null: voice.bind(encounter, stage.boss, encounter.health.terminal)
	var bound_stage := stage as PlainsRegionStage
	var bound_token := lifetime.token()
	encounter.presentation_event.connect(func(event: Dictionary) -> void:
		if event.get("event", &"") != &"windkeeper_death_impact": return
		if not is_instance_valid(bound_stage) or stage != bound_stage or not lifetime.active: return
		if lifetime.epoch != bound_token.run_epoch or lifetime.stage_epoch != bound_token.stage_epoch: return
		if controller.actor_resources.health.terminal or not director.stage_complete: return
		if WindkeeperPressureRewards.spawn(bound_stage, encounter):
			if bound_stage.visual_layer is PlainsStageVisual:
				(bound_stage.visual_layer as PlainsStageVisual).play_boss_defeat(encounter.motor.global_position, false, true)
			director.manifest.record_output(director.stage_index, &"windkeeper_pressure_coins", {"amount": (encounter.definition as WindkeeperPressureDefinition).reward_coin_total, "source": WindkeeperPressureRewards.SOURCE})
	)


func _windkeeper_pressure_rewards_pending() -> bool:
	if not connected_region or not is_instance_valid(stage) or not stage is PlainsRegionStage or not is_instance_valid(stage.boss): return false
	var encounter := stage.boss.get_node("Encounter") as WindkeeperPressureEncounter
	if encounter == null or not encounter.health.terminal or not encounter.physical_reward_expected: return false
	# Airborne deaths first reach their locked real support. The mechanical
	# failure clock starts after landing, independently of the room defeat tick.
	if float(encounter.combat_metrics().get("death_age", 0)) < (encounter.definition as WindkeeperPressureDefinition).death_seconds: return true
	if not stage.region_state.drops.has(WindkeeperPressureRewards.SOURCE): return true
	for pickup: Dictionary in stage.pickups:
		if str(pickup.get("source", "")) == WindkeeperPressureRewards.SOURCE and not pickup.claimed: return true
	return false

func guardian_case() -> void:
	var trace: Node=preload("res://tests/forest_depth_trace_strategy.gd").create()
	trace.seed_value="forest-depth-hollow-00";trace.map_index=1;trace.route_name="fast"
	root.add_child(trace)
	for unused: int in 3000:
		if trace.finished: break
		await frames(1)
	check(trace.finished and trace.failures.is_empty(),"actual formal fast route reaches opened gate without position/resource injection")
	if not trace.finished or not trace.failures.is_empty():
		if is_instance_valid(trace.app): await dispose(trace.app)
		trace.free()
		return
	var app: DemoApp=trace.app
	var stage := app.stage as ThornForestRegionStage
	var duel := stage.boss.get_node("Encounter") as RootbellGuardianV2
	check(duel!=null and duel._duel_bound,"actual App physically binds current Guardian arena")
	if duel==null:
		await dispose(app);trace.free();return
	var phase_events: Array[Dictionary]=[]
	var combat_frames: Array[Dictionary]=[]
	duel.duel_event.connect(func(row: Dictionary) -> void: phase_events.append(row.duplicate(true)))
	app.policy.batch_resolved.connect(func(results: Array[DamageResult]) -> void:
		for result: DamageResult in results:
			phase_events.append({"event":"actual_app_policy_result","source":String(result.request.source_id),"target":String(result.request.target_id),"amount":result.request.amount,"event_id":String(result.request.event_id)})
	)
	var initial_boss_hp:=duel.health.current
	var earned := await earn_current_restore_state(app,duel,combat_frames)
	check(earned,"normal route entry, actual Body cycle, ordinary bullets and actual Bell counter earn V6 phase2 stagger")
	if not earned:
		cases.append({"id":"guardian_app_reload_failed_preparation","events":phase_events,"combat_frames":combat_frames,"route_frames":trace.frames,"route_events":trace.events})
		await dispose(app);trace.free();return
	app._pause_for_menu()
	check(app._boss_started and duel.active and stage.boss_seal.closed,"actual arena entrance starts Guardian and arms seal")
	check(duel.geometry.root_supports.is_empty() and duel.geometry.side_branches.size()==2,"V6 uses two static branches without retired damageable roots")
	check(duel.stage_phase==2 and duel._cycles>0,"real completed Body cycle and normal damage drive phase2")
	check(phase_events.any(func(row: Dictionary) -> bool: return row.event=="duel_phase_changed" and row.phase==2),"actual Guardian phase transition event emitted")
	check(phase_events.any(func(row: Dictionary) -> bool: return row.event=="bell_counter_committed"),"real returned Bell damage committed through Policy")
	stage.capture_state()
	var saved: Dictionary=app.region_state.boss_state.duplicate(true)
	check(saved.duel_version=="guardian-two-action-cycle-v6" and not saved.has("duel_roots"),"current snapshot has exact V6 identity and excludes retired root ledger")
	var paused_snapshot := duel.combat_snapshot().duplicate(true)
	await frames(3)
	check(paused and duel.combat_snapshot()==paused_snapshot,"actual menu pause freezes Boss simulation and body")
	var state := app.region_state
	var old_stage_id := stage.get_instance_id()
	var old_duel_id := duel.get_instance_id()
	var old_actor_epoch := app.lifetime.actor_epoch
	var old_token := app.lifetime.token()
	var malformed_rows: Array = [null,[],[saved.position[0]],["bad",saved.position[1]],[saved.position[0]+1,saved.position[1]],[INF,saved.position[1]]]
	for malformed: Variant in malformed_rows:
		var invalid := saved.duplicate(true)
		invalid.body_position=malformed
		var before := duel.combat_snapshot()
		var hp := duel.health.current
		check(not app._restore_forest_duel(duel,invalid),"App rejects malformed/mismatched body_position "+str(malformed))
		check(duel.combat_snapshot()==before and duel.health.current==hp,"malformed App restore is side-effect free "+str(malformed))
	for invalid_field: String in ["stage_phase","weak_side","intro_duration","next_bell","duel_roots","duel_version","duel_counter_enabled","cycles"]:
		var invalid := saved.duplicate(true)
		invalid[invalid_field] = {"stage_phase":3,"weak_side":0,"intro_duration":INF,"next_bell":1,"duel_roots":{},"duel_version":"guardian-two-action-static-arena-v5","duel_counter_enabled":1,"cycles":0}[invalid_field]
		var before := duel.combat_snapshot()
		check(not app._restore_forest_duel(duel,invalid),"App rejects malformed current duel contract "+invalid_field)
		check(duel.combat_snapshot()==before and duel.health.current==saved.health,"invalid duel contract leaves state untouched "+invalid_field)
	for patch: Dictionary in [{"duel_version":1},{"duel_counter_enabled":null},{"missing_counter":true}]:
		var invalid:=saved.duplicate(true)
		if patch.has("missing_counter"): invalid.erase("duel_counter_enabled")
		else: invalid.merge(patch,true)
		var before:=duel.combat_snapshot()
		check(not app._restore_forest_duel(duel,invalid),"App rejects malformed version/counter type or missing field "+str(patch))
		check(duel.combat_snapshot()==before and duel.health.current==saved.health,"type/missing-field refusal is atomic "+str(patch))
	await app._load_stage() # Required real unload/create/configure/bind/restore path.
	await process_frame # Flush deferred old-stage disposal while simulation remains paused.
	check(app.stage is ThornForestRegionStage and app.stage.assembly_ok,"App reload reassembled v2 stage")
	var loaded := app.stage as ThornForestRegionStage
	var restored := loaded.boss.get_node("Encounter") as RootbellGuardianV2
	check(loaded.get_instance_id()!=old_stage_id and restored.get_instance_id()!=old_duel_id,"actual old Stage/Boss replaced")
	check(app.region_state==state and state.manifest_hash==loaded.generated.manifest.manifest_hash,"App preserves same hash-bound map state")
	check(app.lifetime.actor_epoch>old_actor_epoch and not app.lifetime.accepts(old_token),"reload invalidates old actor token")
	check(restored.last_restore_accepted and restored.geometry.root_supports.is_empty(),"delayed App restore accepted after current arena binding")
	check(restored.health.current==saved.health,"actual reassembled Boss keeps damaged health")
	check(loaded.boss.position.is_equal_approx(Vector2(saved.position[0],saved.position[1])),"actual reassembled moving body position retained")
	check(restored.stage_phase==saved.stage_phase and restored.stage_phase==2,"HP-triggered Guardian phase2 retained")
	check(restored.weak_side==saved.weak_side and is_equal_approx(restored.intro_duration,float(saved.intro_duration)),"current contract weak-side and intro-duration restored unchanged")
	check(saved.mode=="bell_stagger" and restored.mode==&"bell_stagger" and is_equal_approx(restored.clock,float(saved.clock)),"actually earned Bell stagger resumes bounded remaining clock")
	check(restored.combat_snapshot().duel_counter_enabled==saved.duel_counter_enabled,"current counter-enabled contract retained")
	check(restored.attack_epoch>int(saved.attack_epoch) and restored._flight_token==null,"old attack epoch superseded without flight token replay")
	check(restored._attack_serial==int(saved.serial) and restored._cycles==int(saved.cycles) and restored._next_bell==saved.next_bell,"actual serial/cycles/next-bell retained")
	check(loaded.boss_seal.closed and loaded.boss_seal.walls.all(func(wall: StaticBody2D) -> bool: return wall.collision_layer==1),"App rebinds actual closed seal walls")
	var once: Dictionary=restored.combat_snapshot().duplicate(true)
	once["health"]=restored.health.current # Explicit observed HealthState; base combat_snapshot omits HP.
	# The actual active Boss entrance path performs its second restore.
	app._start_generated_boss()
	check(app._boss_started and restored.active and loaded.restored_boss.is_empty(),"active reload consumes saved Boss through actual App activation")
	check(restored.health.current==saved.health and not restored.combat_snapshot().has("duel_roots"),"activation preserves damaged V6 Boss without retired ledger")
	check(restored.attack_epoch>int(once.attack_epoch),"active restoration issues another fresh attack epoch")
	var activated: Dictionary=restored.combat_snapshot()
	activated["health"]=restored.health.current

func earn_current_restore_state(app: DemoApp, duel: RootbellGuardianV2, samples: Array[Dictionary]) -> bool:
	var controller: PlayerController=app.controller
	var player: PlayerMotor=app.player
	var last_hook := -1
	var last_warning := ""
	var jump_until := -1
	var next_shot := 0
	var direction := 1
	for tick: int in 2400:
		if not app.lifetime.active or controller.actor_resources.health.terminal or duel.health.terminal: return false
		if duel.stage_phase==2 and duel._cycles>0 and duel.mode==&"bell_stagger" and duel.clock>0: return true
		if not app._boss_started:
			# Walk from actual gate-ready support into the real arena trigger.
			controller.router.set_move_axis(1)
		else:
			var arena: Array=duel.geometry.boss_arena
			if player.global_position.x>float(arena[0])+float(arena[2])-110: direction=-1
			elif player.global_position.x<float(arena[0])+100: direction=1
			var bell := duel._bell
			if duel.mode in [&"bell_warning",&"bell_watch"] and is_instance_valid(bell) and last_hook!=bell.get_instance_id():
				var branch: Dictionary=duel.geometry.side_branches[0 if bell.facing<0 else 1]
				var x:=float(branch.rect[0])+float(branch.rect[2])*.5
				direction=int(signf(x-player.global_position.x)) if absf(x-player.global_position.x)>4 else 0
			var warning := "%s/%s" % [duel.mode,duel._attack_serial]
			if duel.mode in [&"pursuit_warning",&"bell_warning"] and warning!=last_warning:
				last_warning=warning
				jump_until=tick+12
				if duel.mode==&"pursuit_warning":
					direction=int(signf(player.global_position.x-duel.attack_goal.x))
					if direction==0: direction=-int(signf(duel.motor.global_position.x-player.global_position.x))
			controller.router.set_move_axis(direction)
			controller.router.set_jump_held(&"restore_normal_combat",tick<jump_until)
			if controller.traversal.state==&"free" and not controller.traversal.hook_used and is_instance_valid(bell) and bell.state==&"outbound" and last_hook!=bell.get_instance_id():
				var start:=player.global_position+Vector2(0,-6)
				if start.distance_to(bell.global_position)<controller.traversal.definition.hook_range-12:
					var ray:=PhysicsRayQueryParameters2D.create(start,bell.global_position,0xFFFFFFFF,[player.get_rid()])
					ray.collide_with_areas=true
					if player.get_world_2d().direct_space_state.intersect_ray(ray).get("collider")==bell:
						var predicted:=bell.global_position
						for unused: int in 3:
							var time:=controller.traversal.definition.hook_windup+start.distance_to(predicted)/controller.traversal.definition.hook_flight_speed
							predicted=bell.global_position+bell.velocity*time+Vector2(0,.5*bell.config.bell_gravity*time*time)
						last_hook=bell.get_instance_id()
						controller.router.request_action(&"grapple",(predicted-start).normalized())
			# Real normal bullets earn the low-HP phase, then stop firing so the
			# requested counter state can survive; no HealthState writes or refill.
			if duel.health.current>duel.health.capacity*(duel.definition as BossDuelDefinition).phase2_health_ratio and duel.core_open and tick>=next_shot and not controller.traversal.busy() and controller.traversal.state!=&"hook_kick":
				var half:=duel.definition.collision_size*.5-Vector2(4,4)
				var offsets: Array[Vector2]=[Vector2.ZERO,Vector2(-half.x,-half.y),Vector2(half.x,-half.y),Vector2(0,-half.y),Vector2(-half.x,half.y),Vector2(half.x,half.y)]
				for offset: Vector2 in offsets:
					var aim:=duel.motor.global_position+offset
					var ray:=PhysicsRayQueryParameters2D.create(player.global_position+Vector2(0,-6),aim,13,[player.get_rid()])
					if player.get_world_2d().direct_space_state.intersect_ray(ray).get("collider")!=duel.motor: continue
					controller.router.request_action(&"shoot_release",(aim-player.global_position).normalized())
					next_shot=tick+ceili(player.tuning.shot_cooldown*Engine.physics_ticks_per_second)
					break
		samples.append({"tick":tick,"player_position":[player.global_position.x,player.global_position.y],"player_hp":controller.actor_resources.health.current,"energy":controller.actor_resources.stamina.current,"hook_state":String(controller.traversal.state),"boss":duel.combat_snapshot(),"app_boss_started":app._boss_started})
		await frames(1)
	return false
